import Destructors.Collection
import Functions.Safety

namespace Dada.Destructors
open Shared Shared.Typing
open Functions (Slots heapState from_heap to_heap realized_slots)

theorem DropTyped.statement (typed : DropTyped classes declarations before place core after) :
    StatementTyped classes declarations before core after := by
  cases typed with
  | struct expression structTy => exact .dropStruct expression structTy
  | «class» expression declared signature =>
    apply StatementTyped.call declared (by simp)
    · simpa only [signature, receiver, List.map, FieldType.toType] using
        ArgsTyped.cons expression (.nil expression.wellFormed.2.2)
    · simpa only [signature] using DestinationTyped.none expression.wellFormed.2.2

theorem Satisfies_struct (satisfied : Satisfies classes state reference ty)
    (structTy : StructType classes ty) : StructReference classes.erase state reference := by
  obtain ⟨data, stored, name⟩ := satisfied.root
  obtain ⟨declaration, declared, kind⟩ := structTy.declaration
  exact ⟨data, ⟨declaration.fields.map Prod.fst, declaration.kind⟩, stored,
    List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(ty.base, declaration), lookup_member declared,
      by simp [ValueType.base, name]⟩, kind⟩

theorem Finished.store (finished : Finished classes environment)
    (slots : Slots environment state.variables roots)
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state pending) : StoreFinished classes.erase state := by
  intro name reference member
  have rootMember : reference ∈ roots.map Prod.fst := by
    rw [slots.references]
    exact List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(name, some reference), member, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨ref, ty⟩, typedMember, equality⟩ := List.mem_map.mp rootMember
  dsimp at equality
  subst ref
  obtain ⟨x, envMember, _⟩ := slots.root typedMember
  have sat := (to_heap realized slots).pendingValues reference ty (List.mem_append_left _ typedMember)
  simpa only [StructReference, heapState] using Satisfies_struct sat (finished x ty envMember)

def RetainsClasses (classes : ClassTable) (before after : Configuration) : Prop :=
  ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ before.objects →
    ¬ StructType classes (.whole data.className) → (id, data) ∈ after.objects

theorem collect_safely {configuration : Configuration}
    (discardable : ∀ reference ty, (reference, ty) ∈ garbage → StructType classes ty)
    (classesWf : classes.WellFormed) (declarationsWf : DeclarationsTyped classes declarations)
    (shape : StackShape classes declarations configuration.frames roots)
    (realized : Realizes classes [] (heapState configuration.rootState) (roots ++ garbage)) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes declarations configuration.collect ∧
      RetainsClasses classes configuration configuration.collect := by
  refine ⟨collect_typed classesWf declarationsWf shape realized, ?_⟩
  intro id data stored classObject
  have retained := collectPending_retains_classes realized discardable stored classObject
  rwa [collect_heap shape] at retained

theorem ResultTyped.exists_eval (typed : ResultTyped classes environment value result final)
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state pending) :
    ∃ evaluated reference, ResultEval classes.erase state value evaluated reference ∧
      reference.isSome = result.isSome := by
  cases typed with
  | none _ => exact ⟨state,Option.none,.none _,rfl⟩
  | some expression =>
    obtain ⟨evaluated,reference,evaluation⟩ := (expression.sound _ _ realized).1
    exact ⟨evaluated,Option.some reference,.some evaluation,rfl⟩

theorem DestinationTyped.exists_deliver
    (typed : DestinationTyped classes environment destination result after)
    (slots : Slots environment variables roots)
    (shape : reference.isSome = result.isSome) :
    ∃ delivered, Deliver variables destination reference delivered := by
  cases typed with
  | none _ => cases reference <;> simp at shape; exact ⟨variables,.none _⟩
  | some binding =>
    cases reference with
    | none => cases shape
    | some reference =>
      cases binding with
      | «variable» _ _ fresh =>
        exact ⟨_,.some (slots.keys ▸ fresh)⟩

theorem binding_keys (typed : BindingTyped classes before pattern ty after)
    (operation : Unpacking.Bind classes.erase state reference pattern result)
    (keys : before.map Prod.fst = state.variables.map Prod.fst) :
    after.map Prod.fst = result.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  cases typed with
  | «variable» _ _ _ => cases operation; simp [State.bind, keys]
  | unpack _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ fields _ =>
    cases operation with
    | unpack _ _ _ _ _ transfer => simp [List.map_append, fields.keys, transfer.keys, keys]

theorem parameter_slots (parameters : List Parameter) (references : List Reference)
    (lengths : references.length = parameters.length) :
    Slots (Functions.Signature.environment ⟨parameters,result⟩) (parameterStore parameters references)
      (references.zip (parameters.map (fun p => p.type.toType))) := by
  induction parameters generalizing references with
  | nil => have : references = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp lengths; subst references; exact .nil
  | cons parameter parameters ih =>
    cases references with
    | nil => simp at lengths
    | cons reference references =>
      exact .value parameter.name reference parameter.type.toType (ih references (Nat.succ.inj lengths))

def resultRoots (reference : Option Reference) (result : Option FieldType) : PendingValues :=
  reference.toList.zip (result.toList.map FieldType.toType)

theorem ResultTyped.preserves (typed : ResultTyped classes before value result after)
    (realized : Realizes classes before state pending)
    (evaluation : ResultEval classes.erase state value evaluated reference) :
    Realizes classes after evaluated (resultRoots reference result ++ pending) ∧
      after.map Prod.fst = before.map Prod.fst ∧ evaluated.variables.map Prod.fst = state.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  cases typed with
  | none _ => cases evaluation; exact ⟨realized,rfl,rfl⟩
  | some expression =>
    cases evaluation with
    | some evaluation => exact ⟨(expression.sound _ _ realized).2 _ _ evaluation,expression.keys,evaluation.variable_keys⟩

theorem DestinationTyped.preserves (typed : DestinationTyped classes before destination result after)
    (realized : Realizes classes before ⟨objects,variables,nextId⟩ (resultRoots reference result ++ pending))
    (keys : before.map Prod.fst = variables.map Prod.fst)
    (delivery : Deliver variables destination reference delivered) :
    Realizes classes after ⟨objects,delivered,nextId⟩ pending ∧ after.map Prod.fst = delivered.map Prod.fst := by
  cases typed with
  | none _ => cases delivery; exact ⟨realized,keys⟩
  | some binding =>
    cases delivery with
    | some fresh =>
      exact ⟨binding.preserves_realization_pending realized (.variable fresh),
        by simpa [State.bind] using (binding_keys (state := ⟨objects,variables,nextId⟩)
          (reference := .owned 0) binding (.variable fresh) keys)⟩

theorem ConfigurationTyped.progress {configuration : Configuration}
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes declarations configuration) :
    configuration.finished ∨ ∃ after, Step classes.erase declarations configuration after := by
  rcases configuration with ⟨objects,nextId,frames⟩
  obtain ⟨classesWf,declarationsWf,roots,shape,heap⟩ := typed
  cases shape with
  | done => exact .inl rfl
  | @active frame rest environment localRoots laterRoots result slots envWf body continuation =>
    have realized := from_heap heap slots envWf
    rcases frame with ⟨variables,frameBody,destination⟩
    rcases frameBody with ⟨code,returnValue⟩
    obtain ⟨middle,final,sequence,returned,finished⟩ := body
    right
    cases code with
    | cons first restCode =>
      cases sequence with
      | cons firstTyped tail =>
        cases firstTyped with
        | «local» localTyped =>
          cases localTyped with
          | letValue expression binding =>
            obtain ⟨evaluated,reference,evaluation⟩ := (expression.sound _ _ realized).1
            have evaluatedRealized := (expression.sound _ _ realized).2 _ _ evaluation
            obtain ⟨after,operation⟩ := binding.exists_bind_pending evaluatedRealized
            exact ⟨_,.collect (.local (.letValue evaluation operation))⟩
        | call declared fresh args dest =>
          obtain ⟨evaluated,references,evaluation⟩ := (args.sound _ _ realized).1
          exact ⟨_,.collect (.call declared dest.shape
            (fun x member occupied => fresh x member ((realized.variableDomain x).mpr occupied))
            evaluation (by simpa using evaluation.length.trans args.length))⟩
        | dropStruct expression structTy =>
          obtain ⟨evaluated,reference,evaluation⟩ := (expression.sound _ _ realized).1
          have evaluatedRealized := (expression.sound _ _ realized).2 _ _ evaluation
          exact ⟨_, .collect (.dropStruct evaluation
            (Satisfies_struct (evaluatedRealized.pendingValues _ _ (by simp)) structTy))⟩
    | nil =>
      cases sequence with
      | nil _ =>
        obtain ⟨evaluated,reference,evaluation,resultShape⟩ := returned.exists_eval realized
        cases continuation with
        | done =>
          cases returned with
          | none _ => exact ⟨_,.collect (.exit (finished.store slots realized))⟩
        | caller callerSlots _ delivery _ _ =>
          obtain ⟨variables,delivered⟩ := delivery.exists_deliver callerSlots resultShape
          obtain ⟨evaluatedRealized,staticKeys,runtimeKeys⟩ := returned.preserves realized evaluation
          obtain ⟨discarded,discardedSlots⟩ := realized_slots evaluatedRealized
            (staticKeys.trans (slots.keys.trans runtimeKeys.symm))
          exact ⟨_,.collect (.return evaluation delivered (finished.store discardedSlots evaluatedRealized))⟩

theorem evalArgs_keys (evaluation : EvalArgs classes before arguments after references) :
    after.variables.map Prod.fst = before.variables.map Prod.fst := by
  induction evaluation using EvalArgs.rec (motive_1 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give => trivial
  | giveShare => trivial
  | new => trivial
  | nil => rfl
  | cons first _ _ ih => exact ih.trans first.variable_keys

theorem RawStep.sound {before after : Configuration}
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes declarations before)
    (step : RawStep classes.erase declarations before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes declarations after.collect ∧ RetainsClasses classes after after.collect := by
  obtain ⟨classesWf,declarationsWf,roots,shape,heap⟩ := typed
  cases step with
  | @«local» beforeState afterState statement rest result frames destination operation =>
    cases shape with
    | active slots envWf body continuation =>
      obtain ⟨middle,final,sequence,returned,finished⟩ := body
      cases sequence with
      | cons first tail =>
        cases first with
        | «local» localTyped =>
          cases localTyped with
          | letValue expression binding =>
            cases operation with
            | letValue evaluation bound =>
              have realized := from_heap heap slots envWf
              have evaluated := (expression.sound _ _ realized).2 _ _ evaluation
              have afterRealized := binding.preserves_realization_pending evaluated bound
              have keys := binding_keys binding bound
                (expression.keys.trans (slots.keys.trans evaluation.variable_keys.symm))
              obtain ⟨afterRoots,afterSlots⟩ := realized_slots afterRealized keys
              have afterHeap := to_heap afterRealized afterSlots
              apply collect_safely (garbage := []) (by simp) classesWf declarationsWf
                (.active (frame := ⟨afterState.variables,⟨rest,result⟩,destination⟩) afterSlots afterRealized.environmentWellFormed ⟨middle,final,tail,returned,finished⟩ continuation)
              simpa only [List.append_nil,heapState,Configuration.rootState,Configuration.running] using afterHeap
  | @call beforeState evaluated destination name arguments rest result frames returnTo declaration references
      declared resultShape fresh evaluation lengths =>
    cases shape with
    | active slots envWf body continuation =>
      obtain ⟨middle,final,sequence,returned,finished⟩ := body
      cases sequence with
      | cons first tail =>
        cases first with
        | call expectedMember _ args delivery =>
          have same := member_value_unique declarationsWf.1 expectedMember declared
          cases same
          have realized := from_heap heap slots envWf
          have evaluatedRealized := (args.sound _ _ realized).2 _ _ evaluation
          have keys := args.keys.trans (slots.keys.trans (evalArgs_keys evaluation).symm)
          obtain ⟨callerRoots,callerSlots⟩ := realized_slots evaluatedRealized keys
          have callerHeap := to_heap evaluatedRealized callerSlots
          obtain ⟨signatureWf,calleeBody⟩ := declarationsWf.2 _ declared
          have calleeSlots := parameter_slots (result := declaration.signature.result) declaration.signature.parameters references lengths
          have calleeWf := (BodyFrom.of_declaration calleeBody).sequence_wf
          apply collect_safely (garbage := []) (by simp) classesWf declarationsWf
            (.active (frame := ⟨parameterStore declaration.signature.parameters references,declaration.body,destination⟩) calleeSlots calleeWf calleeBody
              (.caller (caller := ⟨evaluated.variables,⟨rest,result⟩,returnTo⟩) callerSlots evaluatedRealized.environmentWellFormed delivery
                ⟨middle,final,tail,returned,finished⟩ continuation))
          apply callerHeap.perm
          simp only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, List.append_nil]
          apply List.Perm.trans (List.Perm.of_eq (List.append_assoc _ _ _).symm)
          apply List.Perm.trans (List.perm_append_comm.append_right _)
          exact List.Perm.of_eq (List.append_assoc _ _ _)
  | @dropStruct beforeState evaluated place reference rest result frames destination evaluation _ =>
    cases shape with
    | active slots envWf body continuation =>
      obtain ⟨middle,final,sequence,returned,finished⟩ := body
      cases sequence with
      | cons first tail =>
        cases first with
        | dropStruct expression structTy =>
          have realized := from_heap heap slots envWf
          have evaluatedRealized := (expression.sound _ _ realized).2 _ _ evaluation
          have keys := expression.keys.trans (slots.keys.trans evaluation.variable_keys.symm)
          obtain ⟨afterRoots,afterSlots⟩ := realized_slots evaluatedRealized keys
          have afterHeap := to_heap evaluatedRealized afterSlots
          apply collect_safely (garbage := [(reference, _)]) (by
            intro ref ty member; cases List.mem_singleton.mp member; exact structTy) classesWf declarationsWf
            (.active (frame := ⟨evaluated.variables,⟨rest,result⟩,destination⟩) afterSlots
              evaluatedRealized.environmentWellFormed ⟨middle,final,tail,returned,finished⟩ continuation)
          apply afterHeap.perm
          simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] using
            (List.perm_append_comm (l₁ := [(reference, _)])).append_left afterRoots
  | @«return» beforeState evaluated result reference caller frames destination variables evaluation delivered _ =>
    cases shape with
    | active slots envWf body continuation =>
      obtain ⟨middle,final,sequence,returned,finished⟩ := body
      cases sequence with
      | nil _ =>
        cases continuation with
        | @caller _ _ _ _ callerEnvironment resumed callerRoots laterRoots callerResult callerSlots callerWf delivery callerBody rest =>
          have realized := from_heap heap slots envWf
          obtain ⟨evaluatedRealized,staticKeys,runtimeKeys⟩ := returned.preserves realized evaluation
          obtain ⟨discarded,discardedSlots⟩ := realized_slots evaluatedRealized
            (staticKeys.trans (slots.keys.trans runtimeKeys.symm))
          have calleeHeap := to_heap evaluatedRealized discardedSlots
          have callerHeap := calleeHeap.perm (show
              (discarded ++ (resultRoots reference _ ++ (callerRoots ++ laterRoots))).Perm
              (callerRoots ++ (resultRoots reference _ ++ (laterRoots ++ discarded))) from by
            exact List.perm_append_comm.trans (by
              simpa only [List.append_assoc] using
                (List.perm_append_comm (l₁ := resultRoots reference _) (l₂ := callerRoots)).append_right (laterRoots ++ discarded)))
          have callerRealized := from_heap callerHeap callerSlots callerWf
          obtain ⟨resumedRealized,resumedKeys⟩ := delivery.preserves callerRealized callerSlots.keys delivered
          obtain ⟨resumedRoots,resumedSlots⟩ := realized_slots resumedRealized resumedKeys
          have resumedHeap := to_heap resumedRealized resumedSlots
          apply collect_safely (fun ref ty member => by
            obtain ⟨name, envMember, _⟩ := discardedSlots.root member
            exact finished name ty envMember) classesWf declarationsWf (.active (frame := ⟨variables,caller.body,caller.destination⟩) resumedSlots resumedRealized.environmentWellFormed callerBody rest)
          simpa only [List.append_assoc,heapState,Configuration.rootState,Configuration.running] using resumedHeap
  | exit _ =>
    cases shape with
    | active slots envWf body continuation =>
      cases continuation with
      | done =>
        obtain ⟨middle,final,sequence,returned,finished⟩ := body
        cases sequence with
        | nil _ =>
          cases returned with
          | none _ =>
            apply collect_safely (roots := []) (fun ref ty member => by
              obtain ⟨name, envMember, _⟩ := slots.root (by simpa only [List.append_nil] using member)
              exact finished name ty envMember) classesWf declarationsWf .done
            simpa only [List.append_nil, List.nil_append, heapState, Configuration.rootState, Configuration.running] using heap

theorem ConfigurationTyped.preservation {before after : Configuration}
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes declarations before)
    (step : Step classes.erase declarations before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes declarations after := by
  cases step with
  | collect raw => exact (raw.sound typed).1

theorem ConfigurationTyped.trace {before after : Configuration}
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes declarations before)
    (trace : Steps classes.erase declarations before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes declarations after := by
  induction trace with
  | refl => exact typed
  | step first _ ih => exact ih (typed.preservation first)

theorem ConfigurationTyped.finished_heap_empty {configuration : Configuration}
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes declarations configuration)
    (finished : configuration.finished) : configuration.objects = [] := by
  rcases configuration with ⟨objects,nextId,frames⟩
  change frames = [] at finished
  subst frames
  obtain ⟨_,_,roots,shape,heap⟩ := typed
  cases shape
  have same := State.collect_eq_self heap.ownership.no_pending
  rw [heapState,State.collect_no_variables] at same
  exact (congrArg State.objects same).symm

-- Owners retain their multiplicity: two distinct slots holding the same
-- shared reference count twice. Frame-local names need not be globally unique.
theorem ConfigurationTyped.ownership {configuration : Configuration}
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes declarations configuration) :
    (Owners configuration.rootState).Pairwise Compatible ∧
    (∀ id, id ∈ References configuration.rootState ↔ Allocated configuration.rootState id) := by
  obtain ⟨_,_,roots,shape,heap⟩ := typed
  have refs := shape.references
  constructor
  · simpa only [Owners,heapState,List.filterMap_nil,List.nil_append,refs,
      Configuration.rootState] using heap.ownership.ownersCompatible
  · intro id
    have complete := heap.ownership.referencesComplete id
    simpa only [heapState,References,List.filterMap_nil,List.nil_append,refs,
      Configuration.rootState,Allocated,List.map_append,List.map_filterMap,Function.comp_def] using complete

theorem program_safety (typed : ProgramTyped program)
    (trace : Steps program.classes.erase program.declarations (.initial program) configuration) :
    ConfigurationTyped program.classes program.declarations configuration ∧
    (configuration.finished ∨ ∃ after, Step program.classes.erase program.declarations configuration after) ∧
    ¬ Stuck program.classes.erase program.declarations configuration := by
  have preserved := (ConfigurationTyped.initial typed).trace trace
  have progress := preserved.progress
  refine ⟨preserved,progress,?_⟩
  intro stuck
  rcases progress with finished | successor
  · exact stuck.1 finished
  · exact stuck.2 successor

end Dada.Destructors

import Destructors.Typing
import Functions.Realization

namespace Dada.Destructors
open Shared Shared.Typing
open Functions (Slots heapState from_heap to_heap realized_slots)

-- The active body's final expression has this result type; no termination
-- condition is imposed on recursive calls.
def BodyFrom (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) (environment : Environment)
    (body : Body) (result : Option FieldType) : Prop :=
  ∃ middle final, SequenceTyped classes declarations environment body.statements middle ∧
    ResultTyped classes middle body.result result final ∧ Finished classes final

-- A suspended caller is checked starting with the environment that delivery
-- will produce, while its stored locals realize the environment before delivery.
inductive ContinuationTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) : Option VariableId → Option FieldType → List Frame → PendingValues → Prop where
  | done : ContinuationTyped classes declarations none none [] []
  | caller {destination result caller rest environment resumed roots laterRoots callerResult} :
      Slots environment caller.variables roots → environment.WellFormed classes →
      DestinationTyped classes environment destination result resumed →
      BodyFrom classes declarations resumed caller.body callerResult →
      ContinuationTyped classes declarations caller.destination callerResult rest laterRoots →
      ContinuationTyped classes declarations destination result (caller :: rest) (roots ++ laterRoots)

inductive StackShape (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) : List Frame → PendingValues → Prop where
  | done : StackShape classes declarations [] []
  | active {frame rest environment roots laterRoots result} :
      Slots environment frame.variables roots → environment.WellFormed classes →
      BodyFrom classes declarations environment frame.body result →
      ContinuationTyped classes declarations frame.destination result rest laterRoots →
      StackShape classes declarations (frame :: rest) (roots ++ laterRoots)

def ConfigurationTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  classes.WellFormed ∧ DeclarationsTyped classes declarations ∧
  ∃ roots, StackShape classes declarations configuration.frames roots ∧
    Realizes classes [] (heapState configuration.rootState) roots

theorem ContinuationTyped.references (typed : ContinuationTyped classes declarations destination result frames roots) :
    roots.map Prod.fst = (frames.flatMap Frame.variables).filterMap Prod.snd := by
  induction typed with
  | done => rfl
  | caller slots _ _ _ _ ih => simp [List.filterMap_append, slots.references, ih]

theorem StackShape.references (typed : StackShape classes declarations frames roots) :
    roots.map Prod.fst = (frames.flatMap Frame.variables).filterMap Prod.snd := by
  cases typed with
  | done => rfl
  | active slots _ _ continuation => simp [List.filterMap_append, slots.references, continuation.references]

theorem reachable_iff_live (state : State) (roots : List Reference)
    (same : roots = state.variables.filterMap Prod.snd) :
    Reachable state.objects roots object ↔ Live state object := by
  constructor
  · intro reached
    induction reached with
    | root member =>
      rw [same] at member
      obtain ⟨⟨name,slot⟩,stored,value⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp member
      change slot = some _ at value
      subst slot; exact .variable stored
    | field _ stored field ih => exact .field ih stored field
  · intro live
    induction live with
    | «variable» stored => exact .root (same ▸ List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨_,stored,rfl⟩)
    | field _ stored field ih => exact .field ih stored field

theorem collect_heap {configuration : Configuration} (shape : StackShape classes declarations configuration.frames roots) :
    collectPending (heapState configuration.rootState) roots = heapState configuration.collect.rootState := by
  classical
  have live (id : ObjectId) :
      Reachable configuration.objects (roots.map Prod.fst) id ↔ Live configuration.rootState id :=
    reachable_iff_live (object := id) configuration.rootState (roots.map Prod.fst) shape.references
  simp only [collectPending, heapState, rootReferences, List.filterMap_nil, List.append_nil,
    Configuration.collect, Configuration.rootState, State.collect]
  congr 1
  apply List.filter_congr
  intro entry member
  exact propext (live entry.1) ▸ rfl

theorem collect_typed {configuration : Configuration} (classesWf : classes.WellFormed) (declarationsWf : DeclarationsTyped classes declarations)
    (shape : StackShape classes declarations configuration.frames roots)
    (realized : Realizes classes [] (heapState configuration.rootState) (roots ++ garbage)) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes declarations configuration.collect := by
  refine ⟨classesWf,declarationsWf,roots,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa using shape
  · have kept := realized.collect_pending (List.sublist_append_left roots garbage)
    rwa [collect_heap shape] at kept

theorem BodyFrom.of_declaration (typed : BodyTyped classes declarations signature body) :
    BodyFrom classes declarations signature.environment body signature.result := typed

theorem SequenceTyped.wellFormed (typed : SequenceTyped classes declarations before code after) :
    before.WellFormed classes ∧ after.WellFormed classes := by
  induction typed with
  | nil wf => exact ⟨wf,wf⟩
  | cons first _ ih =>
    constructor
    · cases first with
      | «local» t => exact t.wellFormed.1
      | call _ _ args _ => exact args.wellFormed.1
      | dropStruct expression _ => exact expression.wellFormed.1
    · exact ih.2

theorem BodyFrom.sequence_wf (typed : BodyFrom classes declarations environment body result) :
    environment.WellFormed classes := by
  obtain ⟨middle,final,sequence,_⟩ := typed
  exact sequence.wellFormed.1

theorem ConfigurationTyped.initial (typed : ProgramTyped program) :
    ConfigurationTyped program.classes program.declarations (.initial program) := by
  obtain ⟨classesWf,declarationsWf,final,sequence,finished⟩ := typed
  have finalWf := sequence.wellFormed.2
  refine ⟨classesWf,declarationsWf,[],?_,Realizes.empty classesWf⟩
  exact .active (frame := ⟨[], ⟨program.main,none⟩,none⟩) .nil (by simp [Environment.WellFormed])
    ⟨final,final,sequence,.none finalWf,finished⟩ .done

end Dada.Destructors

noncomputable section

namespace Dada.Destructors

open Shared

abbrev Store := List (VariableId × Slot)

structure Frame where
  variables : Store
  body : Body
  destination : Option VariableId
  deriving Repr

structure Configuration where
  objects : List (ObjectId × Object)
  nextId : Nat
  frames : List Frame
  deriving Repr

def Configuration.running (state : State) (body : Body)
    (frames : List Frame := []) (destination : Option VariableId := none) : Configuration :=
  ⟨state.objects, state.nextId, ⟨state.variables, body, destination⟩ :: frames⟩

def Configuration.initial (program : Program) : Configuration :=
  .running State.empty ⟨program.main, none⟩

def Configuration.finished (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  configuration.frames = []

-- Flattening is only for reachability; evaluation uses the top frame alone.
def Configuration.rootState (configuration : Configuration) : State :=
  ⟨configuration.objects, configuration.frames.flatMap Frame.variables, configuration.nextId⟩

def Configuration.roots (configuration : Configuration) : List Reference :=
  configuration.rootState.variables.filterMap Prod.snd

-- A mathematical collector, not an executable graph-traversal algorithm.
def Configuration.collect (configuration : Configuration) : Configuration := by
  exact { configuration with objects := configuration.rootState.collect.objects }

theorem Configuration.collect_frames (configuration : Configuration) :
    configuration.collect.frames = configuration.frames := rfl

theorem Configuration.collect_nextId (configuration : Configuration) :
    configuration.collect.nextId = configuration.nextId := rfl

theorem Configuration.collect_eq_self (configuration : Configuration)
    (rooted : ∀ id data, (id, data) ∈ configuration.objects → Live configuration.rootState id) :
    configuration.collect = configuration := by
  classical
  have same : configuration.objects.filter (fun entry => decide (Live configuration.rootState entry.1)) =
      configuration.objects := List.filter_eq_self.mpr (by
    intro entry member
    simpa using rooted entry.1 entry.2 member)
  change { configuration with objects := (configuration.objects.filter
    (fun entry => decide (Live configuration.rootState entry.1))) } = configuration
  rw [same]

theorem live_has_root (live : Live state object) : ∃ name reference,
    (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables := by
  induction live with
  | «variable» member => exact ⟨_, _, member⟩
  | field _ _ _ ih => exact ih

theorem no_roots_not_live (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat) (object : ObjectId) :
    ¬ Live ⟨objects, [], nextId⟩ object := by
  intro live
  obtain ⟨_, _, member⟩ := live_has_root live
  simp at member

theorem Configuration.collect_empty_frames (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat) :
    (Configuration.mk objects nextId []).collect = ⟨[], nextId, []⟩ := by
  simp [Configuration.collect, State.collect, Configuration.rootState, no_roots_not_live]

theorem Configuration.collect_empty_heap (nextId : Nat) (frames : List Frame) :
    (Configuration.mk [] nextId frames).collect = ⟨[], nextId, frames⟩ := by
  simp [Configuration.collect, State.collect, Configuration.rootState]

def parameterStore (parameters : List Parameter) (references : List Reference) : Store :=
  (parameters.map Functions.Parameter.name).zip (references.map some)

inductive ResultEval (classes : Classes) : State → Option Value → State → Option Reference → Prop where
  | none (state : State) : ResultEval classes state none state none
  | some {before after value reference} :
      Eval classes before value after reference →
      ResultEval classes before (some value) after (some reference)

inductive Deliver : Store → Option VariableId → Option Reference → Store → Prop where
  | none (variables : Store) : Deliver variables none none variables
  | some {variables name reference} :
      name ∉ variables.map Prod.fst →
      Deliver variables (some name) (some reference) ((name, some reference) :: variables)

def DestinationMatches (destination : Option VariableId)
    (result : Option Shared.Typing.FieldType) : Prop :=
  destination.isSome = result.isSome

-- Frame completion is a runtime check of roots, not a view-based test.
def StoreFinished (classes : Classes) (state : State) : Prop :=
  ∀ name reference, (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables →
    StructReference classes state reference

-- Raw transitions transfer all temporary values before collection.
inductive RawStep (classes : Classes) (declarations : Declarations) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | local {before after statement rest result frames destination} :
      Unpacking.Step classes ⟨before, [statement]⟩ ⟨after, []⟩ →
      RawStep classes declarations
        (.running before ⟨.local statement :: rest, result⟩ frames destination)
        (.running after ⟨rest, result⟩ frames destination)
  | call {before evaluated destination name arguments rest result frames returnTo
      declaration references} :
      (name, declaration) ∈ declarations →
      DestinationMatches destination declaration.signature.result →
      (∀ x ∈ destination, x ∉ before.variables.map Prod.fst) →
      EvalArgs classes before arguments evaluated references →
      references.length = declaration.signature.parameters.length →
      RawStep classes declarations
        (.running before ⟨.call destination name arguments :: rest, result⟩ frames returnTo)
        (.running { evaluated with variables := parameterStore declaration.signature.parameters references }
          declaration.body (⟨evaluated.variables, ⟨rest, result⟩, returnTo⟩ :: frames) destination)
  | dropStruct {before evaluated place reference rest result frames destination} :
      Eval classes before (.give place) evaluated reference →
      StructReference classes evaluated reference →
      RawStep classes declarations
        (.running before ⟨.dropStruct place :: rest, result⟩ frames destination)
        (.running evaluated ⟨rest, result⟩ frames destination)
  | «return» {before evaluated result reference caller frames destination variables} :
      ResultEval classes before result evaluated reference →
      Deliver caller.variables destination reference variables →
      StoreFinished classes evaluated →
      RawStep classes declarations
        (.running before ⟨[], result⟩ (caller :: frames) destination)
        (.running { evaluated with variables := variables } caller.body frames caller.destination)
  | exit {objects nextId variables} :
      StoreFinished classes ⟨objects, variables, nextId⟩ →
      RawStep classes declarations
        (.running ⟨objects, variables, nextId⟩ ⟨[], none⟩) ⟨objects, nextId, []⟩

inductive Step (classes : Classes) (declarations : Declarations) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | collect {before raw} : RawStep classes declarations before raw →
      Step classes declarations before raw.collect

inductive Steps (classes : Classes) (declarations : Declarations) : Configuration → Configuration → Prop where
  | refl (configuration : Configuration) : Steps classes declarations configuration configuration
  | step {before middle after} :
      Step classes declarations before middle → Steps classes declarations middle after →
      Steps classes declarations before after

def Stuck (classes : Classes) (declarations : Declarations) (configuration : Configuration) : Prop :=
  ¬ configuration.finished ∧ ¬ ∃ after, Step classes declarations configuration after

theorem finished_no_step (finished : configuration.finished) :
    ¬ Step classes declarations configuration after := by
  intro step
  cases step with
  | collect raw => cases raw <;> simp_all [Configuration.finished, Configuration.running]

theorem terminal_heap_empty (step : Step classes declarations before after)
    (finished : after.finished) : after.objects = [] := by
  cases step with
  | collect raw =>
    cases raw <;> simp_all [Configuration.finished, Configuration.running,
      Configuration.collect_frames, Configuration.collect_empty_frames]

theorem Steps.trans (first : Steps classes declarations before middle)
    (second : Steps classes declarations middle after) : Steps classes declarations before after := by
  induction first with
  | refl => exact second
  | step step _ ih => exact .step step (ih second)

end Dada.Destructors

attribute [simp] Dada.Destructors.Configuration.collect_frames
  Dada.Destructors.Configuration.collect_nextId Dada.Destructors.no_roots_not_live
  Dada.Destructors.Configuration.collect_empty_frames Dada.Destructors.Configuration.collect_empty_heap

end

import Functions.Syntax

namespace Dada.Destructors

open Shared Shared.Typing

-- Call-free values and nominal storage are the explicitly inherited Shared
-- sublanguage. Calls have their own syntax, machine, and typing judgments.
inductive Name where
  | function (name : String)
  | method (owner : ClassName) (name : String)
  | destructor (owner : ClassName)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

abbrev Parameter := Functions.Parameter
abbrev Signature := Functions.Signature

-- Surface receiver prefixes expand only the receiver parameter, not a call.
def receiver (owner : ClassName) (permission : Perm) : Parameter :=
  ⟨"self", ⟨permission, owner⟩⟩

def Signature.WellFormed (classes : ClassTable) (name : Name)
    (signature : Signature) : Prop :=
  (signature.parameters.map Functions.Parameter.name).Nodup ∧
  (∀ p ∈ signature.parameters, Admissible classes p.type.toType) ∧
  (∀ ty ∈ signature.result, Admissible classes ty.toType) ∧
  match name with
  | .function _ => "self" ∉ signature.parameters.map Functions.Parameter.name
  | .destructor owner => signature = ⟨[receiver owner .given], none⟩ ∧
      ∃ declaration, (owner, declaration) ∈ classes ∧ declaration.kind = .classType
  | .method owner _ => match signature.parameters with
    | [] => False
    | first :: rest => first.name = "self" ∧ first.type.className = owner ∧
        "self" ∉ rest.map Functions.Parameter.name

inductive Statement where
  | local (statement : Unpacking.Statement)
  | call (destination : Option VariableId) (name : Name) (arguments : List Value)
  | dropStruct (place : Place)
  deriving Repr

-- Class drops are calls to a distinct namespace, never a user method named drop.
def Statement.dropClass (owner : ClassName) (place : Place) : Statement :=
  .call none (.destructor owner) [.give place]

structure Body where
  statements : List Statement
  result : Option Value
  deriving Repr

structure Declaration where
  signature : Signature
  body : Body
  deriving Repr

abbrev Declarations := List (Name × Declaration)

structure Program where
  classes : ClassTable
  declarations : Declarations
  main : List Statement
  deriving Repr

end Dada.Destructors

import Destructors.Step

namespace Dada.Destructors

open Shared Shared.Typing

inductive ResultTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → Option Value → Option FieldType → Environment → Prop where
  | none {environment} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → ResultTyped classes environment none none environment
  | some {before after value type} :
      ExprTyped classes before value type.toType after →
      ResultTyped classes before (some value) (some type) after

inductive DestinationTyped (classes : ClassTable) : Environment → Option VariableId → Option FieldType → Environment → Prop where
  | none {environment} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → DestinationTyped classes environment none none environment
  | some {before after name type} :
      BindingTyped classes before (.variable name) type.toType after →
      DestinationTyped classes before (some name) (some type) after

def Finished (classes : ClassTable) (environment : Environment) : Prop :=
  ∀ name ty, (name, some ty) ∈ environment → StructType classes ty

-- In a well-typed declaration table, membership supplies the uniquely owned
-- whole receiver signature and excludes destructors on structs.
def Droppable (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) (ty : ValueType) : Prop :=
  Admissible classes ty ∧ (StructType classes ty ∨
    (ty = .whole ty.base .given ∧ .destructor ty.base ∈ declarations.map Prod.fst))

instance (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) (ty : ValueType) :
    Decidable (Droppable classes declarations ty) := by
  unfold Droppable
  infer_instance

inductive StatementTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) : Environment → Statement → Environment → Prop where
  | local {before after statement} :
      Shared.Typing.StatementTyped classes before statement after →
      StatementTyped classes declarations before (.local statement) after
  | call {before middle after destination name arguments declaration} :
      (name, declaration) ∈ declarations →
      (∀ x ∈ destination, x ∉ before.map Prod.fst) →
      ArgsTyped classes before arguments (declaration.signature.parameters.map Functions.Parameter.type) middle →
      DestinationTyped classes middle destination declaration.signature.result after →
      StatementTyped classes declarations before (.call destination name arguments) after

  | dropStruct {before after place ty} :
      ExprTyped classes before (.give place) ty after → StructType classes ty →
      StatementTyped classes declarations before (.dropStruct place) after

-- Elaboration of the single surface form `drop p`. The resolved class name
-- is carried by the core call, so execution needs no dynamic method lookup.
inductive DropTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) : Environment → Place → Statement → Environment → Prop where
  | struct {before after place ty} :
      ExprTyped classes before (.give place) ty after → StructType classes ty →
      DropTyped classes declarations before place (.dropStruct place) after
  | class {before after place owner declaration} :
      ExprTyped classes before (.give place) (.whole owner .given) after →
      (Name.destructor owner, declaration) ∈ declarations →
      declaration.signature = ⟨[receiver owner .given], none⟩ →
      DropTyped classes declarations before place (.dropClass owner place) after

inductive SequenceTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) : Environment → List Statement → Environment → Prop where
  | nil {environment} :
      environment.WellFormed classes → SequenceTyped classes declarations environment [] environment
  | cons {before middle after statement rest} :
      StatementTyped classes declarations before statement middle →
      SequenceTyped classes declarations middle rest after →
      SequenceTyped classes declarations before (statement :: rest) after

def BodyTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) (signature : Signature)
    (body : Body) : Prop :=
  ∃ middle after,
    SequenceTyped classes declarations signature.environment body.statements middle ∧
    ResultTyped classes middle body.result signature.result after ∧ Finished classes after

def DeclarationsTyped (classes : ClassTable) (declarations : Declarations) : Prop :=
  (declarations.map Prod.fst).Nodup ∧
    ∀ entry ∈ declarations,
      Signature.WellFormed classes entry.1 entry.2.signature ∧
      BodyTyped classes declarations entry.2.signature entry.2.body

def ProgramTyped (program : Program) : Prop :=
  program.classes.WellFormed ∧ DeclarationsTyped program.classes program.declarations ∧
    ∃ finalEnvironment,
      SequenceTyped program.classes program.declarations [] program.main finalEnvironment ∧
      Finished program.classes finalEnvironment

theorem DestinationTyped.shape
    (typed : DestinationTyped classes before destination result after) :
    DestinationMatches destination result := by
  cases typed <;> rfl

theorem call_arity
    (typed : StatementTyped classes declarations before (.call destination name arguments) after) :
    ∃ declaration, (name, declaration) ∈ declarations ∧
      arguments.length = declaration.signature.parameters.length ∧
      DestinationMatches destination declaration.signature.result := by
  cases typed with
  | call declared _ args dest =>
    exact ⟨_, declared, by simpa using args.length, dest.shape⟩

theorem give_subtype (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after) :
    ∀ place, value = .give place → ∃ source,
      Shared.Typing.give classes before place = some (source, after) ∧ Subtype classes source ty := by
  induction typed using ExprTyped.rec (motive_2 := fun _ _ _ _ _ => True) with
  | give _ taken _ _ => intro place eq; cases eq; exact ⟨_, taken, .refl _ _⟩
  | giveShare => intro place eq; cases eq
  | new => intro place eq; cases eq
  | weaken _ _ subtype ih =>
    intro place eq
    obtain ⟨source, taken, previous⟩ := ih place eq
    exact ⟨source, taken, previous.trans subtype⟩
  | nil => trivial
  | cons => trivial

theorem drop_requires_declaration
    (typed : StatementTyped classes declarations before (.dropClass owner place) after) :
    .destructor owner ∈ declarations.map Prod.fst := by
  cases typed with
  | call declared _ _ _ => exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, declared, rfl⟩

end Dada.Destructors

namespace Dada.Functions.Checks

open Shared Shared.Typing

def classes : ClassTable :=
  [("Token", ⟨[], .classType⟩), ("Point", ⟨[], .structType⟩),
   ("Box", ⟨[("child", ⟨.given, "Token"⟩)], .classType⟩),
   ("Pair", ⟨[("left", ⟨.given, "Token"⟩), ("right", ⟨.given, "Token"⟩)], .classType⟩)]

def ownedToken : FieldType := ⟨.given, "Token"⟩
def ownedPoint : FieldType := ⟨.given, "Point"⟩
def sharedPoint : FieldType := ⟨.shared, "Point"⟩

def identity : Declaration :=
  ⟨⟨[⟨"token", ownedToken⟩], some ownedToken⟩, ⟨[], some (.give (.variable "token"))⟩⟩

def copy : Declaration :=
  ⟨⟨[⟨"point", sharedPoint⟩], some sharedPoint⟩, ⟨[], some (.give (.variable "point"))⟩⟩

def takeMethod : Declaration :=
  ⟨⟨[receiver "Point" .given], some ownedPoint⟩, ⟨[], some (.give (.variable "self"))⟩⟩

def copyMethod : Declaration :=
  ⟨⟨[receiver "Point" .shared], some sharedPoint⟩, ⟨[], some (.give (.variable "self"))⟩⟩

def leave : Declaration := ⟨⟨[⟨"token", ownedToken⟩], none⟩, ⟨[], none⟩⟩

def consume : Declaration :=
  ⟨leave.signature, ⟨[.local ⟨.unpack "Token" [], .give (.variable "token")⟩], none⟩⟩

def declarations : Declarations :=
  [(.function "identity", identity), (.function "copy", copy),
   (.method "Point" "take", takeMethod), (.method "Point" "copy", copyMethod),
   (.function "leave", leave), (.function "consume", consume)]

private theorem token_give : ExprTyped classes [("token", some ownedToken.toType)]
    (.give (.variable "token")) ownedToken.toType [("token", none)] :=
  .give (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)

private theorem point_copy : ExprTyped classes [("point", some sharedPoint.toType)]
    (.give (.variable "point")) sharedPoint.toType [("point", some sharedPoint.toType)] :=
  .give (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)

private theorem identity_body : BodyTyped classes declarations identity.signature identity.body :=
  ⟨_, _, .nil (by decide), .some token_give⟩

private theorem copy_body : BodyTyped classes declarations copy.signature copy.body :=
  ⟨_, _, .nil (by decide), .some point_copy⟩

private theorem take_body : BodyTyped classes declarations takeMethod.signature takeMethod.body :=
  ⟨_, [("self", none)], .nil (by decide),
    .some (.give (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide))⟩

private theorem copy_method_body : BodyTyped classes declarations copyMethod.signature copyMethod.body :=
  ⟨_, takeMethod.signature.environment.map (fun (n, _) => (n, some sharedPoint.toType)),
    .nil (by decide), .some (.give (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide))⟩

private theorem leave_body : BodyTyped classes declarations leave.signature leave.body :=
  ⟨_, _, .nil (by decide), .none (by decide)⟩

private theorem consume_statement : Shared.Typing.StatementTyped classes leave.signature.environment
    ⟨.unpack "Token" [], .give (.variable "token")⟩ [("token", none)] := by
  apply Shared.Typing.StatementTyped.letValue token_give
  exact .unpack (declaration := ⟨[], .classType⟩) (bindings := [])
    (by decide) (by decide) rfl rfl (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
    .nil (by decide)

private theorem consume_body : BodyTyped classes declarations consume.signature consume.body :=
  ⟨_, _, .cons (.local consume_statement) (.nil (by decide)), .none (by decide)⟩

theorem declarations_typed : DeclarationsTyped classes declarations := by
  constructor
  · decide
  · intro entry member
    simp only [declarations, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at member
    rcases member with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨by decide, identity_body⟩
    · exact ⟨by decide, copy_body⟩
    · exact ⟨by decide, take_body⟩
    · exact ⟨by decide, copy_method_body⟩
    · exact ⟨by decide, leave_body⟩
    · exact ⟨by decide, consume_body⟩

def identityCode : List Statement :=
  [.local ⟨.variable "original", .new "Token" []⟩,
   .call (some "result") (.function "identity") [.give (.variable "original")]]

def identityProgram : Program := ⟨classes, declarations, identityCode⟩

def identityReturned : Configuration :=
  (.running ⟨[(0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)], [("result", some (.owned 0)), ("original", none)], 1⟩ ⟨[], none⟩)

private theorem identity_main : SequenceTyped classes declarations [] identityCode
    [("result", some ownedToken.toType), ("original", none)] := by
  apply SequenceTyped.cons (middle := [("original", some ownedToken.toType)])
  · apply StatementTyped.local
    apply Shared.Typing.StatementTyped.letValue (middle := []) (ty := ownedToken.toType)
    · exact .new (declaration := ⟨[], .classType⟩) (by decide) (.nil (by decide))
        (by decide) (by decide)
    · exact .variable (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
  · apply SequenceTyped.cons
    · apply StatementTyped.call (declaration := identity) (middle := [("original", none)])
      · simp [declarations]
      · decide
      · exact .cons (.give (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)) (.nil (by decide))
      · exact .some (.variable (by decide) (by decide) (by decide))
    · exact .nil (by decide)

private theorem new_token (variables : Store) :
    Eval classes.erase ⟨[], variables, 0⟩ (.new "Token" [])
      ⟨[(0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)], variables, 1⟩ (.owned 0) :=
  .new (declaration := ⟨[], .classType⟩) (references := []) (by decide) (.nil _)
    rfl (by simp) (by simp [StructArguments, Kind.isStruct])

private theorem move_head (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat)
    (name : String) (object : ObjectId) (rest : Store) :
    Eval classes.erase ⟨objects, (name, some (.owned object)) :: rest, nextId⟩
      (.give (.variable name)) ⟨objects, (name, none) :: rest, nextId⟩ (.owned object) :=
  .give (.move (source := .variable name) (.variable (reference := .owned object) (by simp)) (.variable objects nextId [] rest name object))

private theorem copy_head (objects : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat)
    (name : String) (object : ObjectId) (rest : Store) :
    Eval classes.erase ⟨objects, (name, some (.shared object)) :: rest, nextId⟩
      (.give (.variable name)) ⟨objects, (name, some (.shared object)) :: rest, nextId⟩ (.shared object) :=
  .give (.copy (source := .variable name) (.variable (reference := .shared object) (by simp)) (by simp [Stored]))

private theorem leaf_live (id : ObjectId) (className : String) (variables : Store)
    (nextId : Nat) (object : ObjectId) :
    Live ⟨[(id, ⟨className, []⟩)], variables, nextId⟩ object ↔
      ∃ name reference, (name, some reference) ∈ variables ∧ reference.object = object := by
  constructor
  · intro live
    cases live with

  simpa [recursionState, recur, List.replicate_succ, parameterStore, State.empty, Configuration.running] using

-- A suspended caller roots both its container and its child while a callee runs.
def callerHeap : List (ObjectId × Object) :=
  [(1, ⟨"Box", [("child", some (.owned 0))]⟩), (0, ⟨"Token", []⟩)]

def savedFrame : Frame := ⟨[("box", some (.owned 1))], ⟨[], none⟩, none⟩

def gcBefore : Configuration :=
  .running ⟨callerHeap, [], 2⟩ ⟨[.local ⟨.variable "temporary", .new "Token" []⟩], none⟩ [savedFrame]

def gcDuring : Configuration :=
  .running ⟨(2, ⟨"Token", []⟩) :: callerHeap, [("temporary", some (.owned 2))], 3⟩
    ⟨[], none⟩ [savedFrame]

def gcAfter : Configuration :=
  .running ⟨callerHeap, savedFrame.variables, 3⟩ savedFrame.body

private theorem caller_root (heap : List (ObjectId × Object)) (nextId : Nat) :
    Live ⟨heap, savedFrame.variables, nextId⟩ 1 :=
  .variable (name := "box") (reference := .owned 1) (by simp [savedFrame])

private theorem gc_local : Step classes.erase declarations gcBefore gcDuring := by
  apply checked_step
  · apply RawStep.local
    apply Unpacking.Step.letValue
    · exact .new (declaration := ⟨[], .classType⟩) (references := [])
        (by decide) (.nil _) rfl (by decide) (by simp [StructArguments, Kind.isStruct])
    · exact .variable (by simp [State.allocate])
  · apply Configuration.collect_eq_self
    intro id data member
    simp only [gcDuring, Configuration.running, callerHeap, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil,
      or_false, Prod.mk.injEq] at member
    rcases member with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact .variable (name := "temporary") (reference := .owned 2) (by simp [gcDuring, Configuration.rootState,
        Configuration.running, savedFrame])
    · exact .variable (name := "box") (reference := .owned 1) (by simp [gcDuring, Configuration.rootState,
        Configuration.running, savedFrame])
    · apply Live.field (parent := 1) (data := ⟨"Box", [("child", some (.owned 0))]⟩)
        (name := "child") (reference := .owned 0)
      · exact .variable (name := "box") (reference := .owned 1) (by simp [gcDuring, Configuration.rootState,
          Configuration.running, savedFrame])
      · simp [gcDuring, Configuration.rootState, Configuration.running, callerHeap]
      · simp

private theorem remaining_live (id : ObjectId) :
    Live ⟨(2, ⟨"Token", []⟩) :: callerHeap, savedFrame.variables, 3⟩ id ↔ id = 0 ∨ id = 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro live
    cases live with
    | «variable» member =>
      simp only [savedFrame, List.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at member
      obtain ⟨_, rfl⟩ := member
      exact .inr rfl
    | field _ stored field =>
      simp only [callerHeap, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, Prod.mk.injEq] at stored
      rcases stored with ⟨_, rfl⟩ | ⟨_, rfl⟩ | ⟨_, rfl⟩
      · simp at field
      · simp only [List.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq, Option.some.injEq] at field
        obtain ⟨_, rfl⟩ := field
        exact .inl rfl
      · simp at field
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact .field (parent := 1) (data := ⟨"Box", [("child", some (.owned 0))]⟩)
        (name := "child") (reference := .owned 0) (caller_root _ _)
        (by simp [callerHeap]) (by simp)
    · exact caller_root _ _

private theorem gc_return : Step classes.erase declarations gcDuring gcAfter := by
  apply collected_step (RawStep.return (.none _) (.none _))
  have characterization := remaining_live
  dsimp [callerHeap, savedFrame] at characterization
  simp +instances [Configuration.collect, State.collect, Configuration.rootState, Configuration.running,
    savedFrame, gcAfter, List.flatMap, List.map, List.flatten,
    characterization, callerHeap]
  decide

-- ANCHOR: gc
example : Step classes.erase declarations gcBefore gcDuring ∧
    gcDuring.objects.length = 3 ∧
    Step classes.erase declarations gcDuring gcAfter ∧
    gcAfter.objects = callerHeap ∧
    Step classes.erase declarations gcAfter ⟨[], 3, []⟩ ∧
    (Configuration.mk [] 3 []).finished ∧
    Step classes.erase declarations (.initial ⟨classes, declarations, []⟩) ⟨[], 0, []⟩ :=
  ⟨gc_local, rfl, gc_return, rfl, collected_step .exit (by simp), rfl,
    collected_step .exit (by simp)⟩
-- ANCHOR_END: gc

end Dada.Functions.Checks

-- A store and its environment describe the same ordered slots. The third
-- index lists exactly the initialized references, decorated with their types.
inductive Slots : Environment → Store → PendingValues → Prop where
  | nil : Slots [] [] []
  | empty {environment variables roots} (name) : Slots environment variables roots →
      Slots ((name, none) :: environment) ((name, none) :: variables) roots
  | value {environment variables roots} (name reference ty) : Slots environment variables roots →
      Slots ((name, some ty) :: environment) ((name, some reference) :: variables) ((reference, ty) :: roots)

theorem Slots.keys (slots : Slots environment variables roots) :
    environment.map Prod.fst = variables.map Prod.fst := by
  induction slots <;> simp_all

theorem Slots.references (slots : Slots environment variables roots) :
    roots.map Prod.fst = variables.filterMap Prod.snd := by
  induction slots <;> simp_all

theorem Slots.root (slots : Slots environment variables roots) (member : (reference, ty) ∈ roots) :
    ∃ name, (name, some ty) ∈ environment ∧ (name, some reference) ∈ variables := by
  induction slots with
  | nil => simp at member
  | empty name _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨name', e, v⟩ := ih member
    exact ⟨name', List.mem_cons_of_mem _ e, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ v⟩
  | value name ref type _ ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | later
    · cases same; exact ⟨name, by simp, by simp⟩
    · obtain ⟨name', e, v⟩ := ih later
      exact ⟨name', List.mem_cons_of_mem _ e, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ v⟩

theorem Slots.empty_slot (slots : Slots environment variables roots) (member : (name, none) ∈ environment) :
    (name, none) ∈ variables := by
  induction slots with
  | nil => simp at member
  | empty x _ ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | later
    · cases same; simp
    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih later)
  | value x ref ty _ ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | later
    · cases same
    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih later)

theorem Slots.initialized (slots : Slots environment variables roots) (member : (name, some ty) ∈ environment) :
    ∃ reference, (name, some reference) ∈ variables ∧ (reference, ty) ∈ roots := by
  induction slots with
  | nil => simp at member
  | empty x _ ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | later
    · cases same
    · obtain ⟨r,v,p⟩ := ih later; exact ⟨r,List.mem_cons_of_mem _ v,p⟩
  | value x ref type _ ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | later
    · cases same; exact ⟨ref,by simp,by simp⟩
    · obtain ⟨r,v,p⟩ := ih later
      exact ⟨r,List.mem_cons_of_mem _ v,List.mem_cons_of_mem _ p⟩

inductive Paired (R : A → B → Prop) : List A → List B → Prop where
  | nil : Paired R [] []
  | cons {a b as bs} : R a b → Paired R as bs → Paired R (a :: as) (b :: bs)

theorem Slots.exists_of_matches
    (keys : environment.map Prod.fst = variables.map Prod.fst)
    (matchedSlots : Paired (fun e v => e.1 = v.1 ∧ SlotMatches classes state v.2 e.2) environment variables) :
    ∃ roots, Slots environment variables roots := by
  induction matchedSlots with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], .nil⟩
  | @cons e v es vs first rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨same, matched⟩ := first
    obtain ⟨roots, tail⟩ := ih (List.cons.inj keys).2
    rcases e with ⟨name,ty⟩; rcases v with ⟨name',ref⟩
    simp only at same; subst name'
    cases ty <;> cases ref <;> simp only [SlotMatches] at matched
    · exact ⟨roots, .empty name tail⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .value _ _ _ tail⟩

theorem realized_slots (realized : Realizes classes environment state pending)
    (keys : environment.map Prod.fst = state.variables.map Prod.fst) :
    ∃ roots, Slots environment state.variables roots := by
  apply Slots.exists_of_matches keys
  have paired : ∀ (es : Environment) (vs : Store),
      es.map Prod.fst = vs.map Prod.fst →
      (∀ entry ∈ es, entry ∈ environment) → (∀ entry ∈ vs, entry ∈ state.variables) →
      Paired (fun e v => e.1 = v.1 ∧ SlotMatches classes state v.2 e.2) es vs := by
    intro es
    induction es with
    | nil => intro vs key _ _; have : vs = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by simpa using congrArg List.length key.symm); subst vs; exact .nil
    | cons e es ih =>
      intro vs key subE subV
      cases vs with
      | nil => simp at key
      | cons v vs =>
        have same := (List.cons.inj key).1
        refine .cons ⟨same, ?_⟩ (ih vs (List.cons.inj key).2
          (fun entry h => subE entry (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h))
          (fun entry h => subV entry (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)))
        rcases e with ⟨name,ty⟩; rcases v with ⟨name',ref⟩
        simp only at same; subst name'
        have em := subE _ (List.mem_cons_self ..)
        have vm := subV _ (List.mem_cons_self ..)
        cases ty with
        | none =>
          have eq := member_value_unique realized.ownership.variableKeys vm (realized.emptyVariables _ em)
          subst ref; trivial
        | some ty =>
          obtain ⟨r,stored,sat⟩ := realized.initializedVariables _ _ em
          have eq := member_value_unique realized.ownership.variableKeys vm stored
          subst ref; exact sat
  exact paired _ _ keys (fun _ h => h) (fun _ h => h)

private theorem compatible_symm {first second : Reference} (h : Compatible first second) : Compatible second first := by
  rcases h with different | shared
  · exact .inl (Ne.symm different)
  · exact .inr ⟨shared.2,shared.1⟩

private theorem owners_targets (state : State) : (Owners state).map Reference.object = References state := by
  simp [Owners, References, List.map_filterMap, List.map_flatMap]

-- Repartitioning the roots between locals and pending references does not
-- change the heap, ownership occurrences, or any view observations.
theorem reroot (realized : Realizes classes oldEnvironment oldState oldPending)
    (objects : newState.objects = oldState.objects) (counter : newState.nextId = oldState.nextId)
    (environmentWf : newEnvironment.WellFormed classes)
    (variableKeys : (newState.variables.map Prod.fst).Nodup)
    (owners : (oldPending.map Prod.fst ++ Owners oldState).Perm (newPending.map Prod.fst ++ Owners newState))
    (pendingTypes : ∀ r t, (r,t) ∈ newPending → Admissible classes t)
    (domain : ∀ name, name ∈ newEnvironment.map Prod.fst ↔ name ∈ newState.variables.map Prod.fst)
    (empty : ∀ name, (name,none) ∈ newEnvironment → (name,none) ∈ newState.variables)
    (initialized : ∀ name ty, (name,some ty) ∈ newEnvironment →
      ∃ r, (name,some r) ∈ newState.variables ∧ Satisfies classes oldState r ty)
    (pendingValues : ∀ r t, (r,t) ∈ newPending → Satisfies classes oldState r t) :
    Realizes classes newEnvironment newState newPending := by
  constructor
  · exact realized.classesWellFormed
  · exact environmentWf
  · exact pendingTypes
  · constructor
    · simpa [objects] using realized.ownership.objectKeys
    · exact variableKeys
    · simpa [objects] using realized.ownership.shapes
    · simpa [objects,counter] using realized.ownership.bounds
    · simpa [objects] using realized.ownership.older
    · exact owners.pairwise realized.ownership.ownersCompatible compatible_symm
    · intro id
      have eq := (owners.map Reference.object).mem_iff (a := id)
      simp only [List.map_append, owners_targets] at eq
      exact eq.symm.trans ((realized.ownership.referencesComplete id).trans (by simp [Allocated,objects]))
  · simpa [FieldsMatchClasses,objects] using realized.fields
  · exact domain
  · exact empty
  · intro name ty member
    obtain ⟨r,stored,sat⟩ := initialized _ _ member
    exact ⟨r,stored,sat.same_objects objects.symm⟩
  · intro r t member; exact (pendingValues _ _ member).same_objects objects.symm

def heapState (state : State) : State := ⟨state.objects,[],state.nextId⟩

theorem to_heap (realized : Realizes classes environment state pending)
    (slots : Slots environment state.variables roots) :
    Realizes classes [] (heapState state) (roots ++ pending) := by
  apply reroot (newState := heapState state) (newPending := roots ++ pending) realized rfl rfl (by simp [Environment.WellFormed]) (by simp [heapState])
  · simp only [List.map_append, Owners, heapState, List.filterMap_nil, List.nil_append, ← slots.references]
    simpa only [List.append_assoc] using (List.perm_append_comm (l₁ := pending.map Prod.fst) (l₂ := roots.map Prod.fst)).append_right (state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap Prod.snd))
  · intro r t member
    rcases List.mem_append.mp member with localRoot | p
    · obtain ⟨name,e,_⟩ := slots.root localRoot
      exact Environment.admissible realized.environmentWellFormed e
    · exact realized.pendingTypes _ _ p
  · simp [heapState]
  · simp
  · simp
  · intro r t member
    rcases List.mem_append.mp member with localRoot | p
    · obtain ⟨name,e,v⟩ := slots.root localRoot
      obtain ⟨r',v',sat⟩ := realized.initializedVariables _ _ e
      have eq := member_value_unique realized.ownership.variableKeys v v'
      cases eq; exact sat
    · exact realized.pendingValues _ _ p

theorem from_heap (realized : Realizes classes [] (heapState state) (roots ++ pending))
    (slots : Slots environment variables roots) (wf : environment.WellFormed classes) :
    Realizes classes environment ⟨state.objects,variables,state.nextId⟩ pending := by
  apply reroot (newState := ⟨state.objects,variables,state.nextId⟩) (newPending := pending) realized rfl rfl wf (slots.keys ▸ wf.1)
  · simp only [List.map_append, Owners, heapState, List.filterMap_nil, List.nil_append, ← slots.references]
    simpa only [List.append_assoc] using (List.perm_append_comm (l₁ := roots.map Prod.fst) (l₂ := pending.map Prod.fst)).append_right (state.objects.flatMap (fun entry => entry.2.fields.filterMap Prod.snd))
  · intro r t member; exact realized.pendingTypes _ _ (List.mem_append_right _ member)
  · intro name; rw [slots.keys]
  · intro name member; exact slots.empty_slot member
  · intro name ty member
    obtain ⟨r,v,p⟩ := slots.initialized member
    exact ⟨r,v,realized.pendingValues _ _ (List.mem_append_left _ p)⟩
  · intro r t member; exact realized.pendingValues _ _ (List.mem_append_right _ member)

end Dada.Functions
