def ownerOccurrences (state : State) : List (StoragePlace × Reference) :=
  state.variables.filterMap (fun (name, slot) => slot.map fun reference => (.variable name, reference)) ++
  state.objects.flatMap (fun (parent, data) => data.fields.filterMap
    (fun (name, slot) => slot.map fun reference => (.field parent name, reference)))

theorem ownerOccurrences_references (state : State) :
    (ownerOccurrences state).map Prod.snd = Owners state := by
  simp [ownerOccurrences, Owners, List.map_append, List.map_flatMap,
    List.map_filterMap, Function.comp_def, Option.map_map]

theorem stored_ownerOccurrence (stored : Stored state place (some reference)) :
    (place, reference) ∈ ownerOccurrences state := by
  cases place with
  | «variable» name =>
    exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_filterMap.mpr
      ⟨(name, some reference), stored, rfl⟩)
  | field parent name =>
    obtain ⟨data, atObject, atField⟩ := stored
    exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨(parent, data), atObject,
      List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(name, some reference), atField, rfl⟩⟩)

theorem stored_owner (stored : Stored state place (some reference)) : reference ∈ Owners state := by
  rw [← ownerOccurrences_references]
  exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, stored_ownerOccurrence stored, rfl⟩

private theorem occurrence_eq_or_compatible {owners : List (StoragePlace × Reference)}
    (pairwise : owners.Pairwise (fun a b => Compatible a.2 b.2))
    (first : a ∈ owners) (second : b ∈ owners) : a = b ∨ Compatible a.2 b.2 := by
  induction owners with
  | nil => simp at first
  | cons head tail ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp first with firstEq | firstTail
    · subst a
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp second with secondEq | secondTail
      · exact Or.inl secondEq.symm
      · exact Or.inr ((List.pairwise_cons.mp pairwise).1 _ secondTail)
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp second with secondEq | secondTail
      · subst b
        apply Or.inr
        rcases (List.pairwise_cons.mp pairwise).1 _ firstTail with different | shared
        · exact Or.inl different.symm
        · exact Or.inr ⟨shared.2, shared.1⟩
      · exact ih pairwise.of_cons firstTail secondTail

private theorem reference_eq_or_compatible {owners : List Reference}
    (pairwise : owners.Pairwise Compatible)
    (first : a ∈ owners) (second : b ∈ owners) : a = b ∨ Compatible a b := by
  induction owners with
  | nil => simp at first
  | cons head tail ih =>
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp first with firstEq | firstTail
    · subst a
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp second with secondEq | secondTail
      · exact Or.inl secondEq.symm
      · exact Or.inr ((List.pairwise_cons.mp pairwise).1 _ secondTail)
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp second with secondEq | secondTail
      · subst b
        apply Or.inr
        rcases (List.pairwise_cons.mp pairwise).1 _ firstTail with different | shared
        · exact Or.inl different.symm
        · exact Or.inr ⟨shared.2, shared.1⟩
      · exact ih pairwise.of_cons firstTail secondTail

theorem unique_owner (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (owned : Stored state place (some (.owned object)))
    (stored : Stored state otherPlace (some reference))
    (target : reference.object = object) :
    otherPlace = place ∧ reference = .owned object := by
  have pairwise : (ownerOccurrences state).Pairwise (fun a b => Compatible a.2 b.2) := by
    apply List.pairwise_map.mp
    simpa [ownerOccurrences_references] using
      (List.pairwise_append.mp wf.ownersCompatible).2.1
  rcases occurrence_eq_or_compatible pairwise (stored_ownerOccurrence owned)
      (stored_ownerOccurrence stored) with same | compatible
  · exact ⟨(congrArg Prod.fst same).symm, (congrArg Prod.snd same).symm⟩
  · rcases compatible with different | shared
    · exact False.elim (different target.symm)
    · cases shared.1

theorem pending_stored_compatible (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (root : reference ∈ pending) (stored : Stored state place (some other)) :
    Compatible reference other :=
  (List.pairwise_append.mp wf.ownersCompatible).2.2 _ root _ (stored_owner stored)

inductive RootSite where
  | variable (name : VariableId)
  | pending (object : ObjectId)
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

inductive RootOwns (state : State) (pending : List Reference) : RootSite → Reference → Prop where
  | variable : (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables →
      RootOwns state pending (.variable name) reference
  | pending : reference ∈ pending → RootOwns state pending (.pending reference.object) reference

inductive Route (state : State) (pending : List Reference) :
    RootSite → List FieldName → Reference → Prop where
  | root : RootOwns state pending site reference → Route state pending site [] reference
  | field : Route state pending site path parent → (parent.object, data) ∈ state.objects →
      (name, some reference) ∈ data.fields →
      Route state pending site (path ++ [name]) (enter parent.mode reference)

private theorem reference_owned {reference : Reference} (unique : reference.mode = .unique) :
    reference = .owned reference.object := by
  cases reference with
  | reference mode object => dsimp at unique; subst mode; rfl

theorem RootOwns.unique {pending : List Reference} (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (left : RootOwns state pending first (.owned object))
    (right : RootOwns state pending second reference) (target : reference.object = object) :
    first = second ∧ reference = .owned object := by
  cases left with
  | «variable» left =>
    cases right with
    | «variable» right =>
      obtain ⟨same, ref⟩ := unique_owner wf
        (show Stored state (.variable _) _ from left)
        (show Stored state (.variable _) _ from right) target
      cases same
      exact ⟨rfl, ref⟩
    | pending right =>
      rcases pending_stored_compatible wf right (show Stored state (.variable _) _ from left) with
        different | shared
      · exact False.elim (different target)
      · cases shared.2
  | pending left =>
    cases right with
    | «variable» right =>
      rcases pending_stored_compatible wf left (show Stored state (.variable _) _ from right) with
        different | shared
      · exact False.elim (different target.symm)
      · cases shared.1
    | pending right =>
      have same : reference = .owned object := by
        rcases reference_eq_or_compatible
            (List.pairwise_append.mp wf.ownersCompatible).1 left right with same | relation
        · exact same.symm
        · rcases relation with different | shared
          · exact False.elim (different target.symm)
          · cases shared.1
      subst reference
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

theorem RootOwns.not_unique_field {pending : List Reference} (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (root : RootOwns state pending site reference)
    (stored : Stored state (.field parent name) (some (.owned object)))
    (target : reference.object = object) : False := by
  cases root with
  | «variable» atRoot =>
    have same := (unique_owner wf stored (show Stored state (.variable _) _ from atRoot) target).1
    cases same
  | pending atRoot =>
    rcases pending_stored_compatible wf atRoot stored with different | shared
    · exact different target
    · cases shared.2

theorem RootOwns.unique_not_field {pending : List Reference}
    (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (root : RootOwns state pending site (.owned object))
    (stored : Stored state (.field parent name) (some reference))
    (target : reference.object = object) : False := by
  cases root with
  | «variable» atRoot =>
    have same := (unique_owner wf (show Stored state (.variable _) _ from atRoot) stored target).1
    cases same
  | pending atRoot =>
    rcases pending_stored_compatible wf atRoot stored with different | shared
    · exact different target.symm
    · cases shared.1

-- A wholly unique route is the only route to its target, even when pending
-- expression values are counted as roots. Shared routes may meet freely.
theorem Route.unique (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (left : Route state pending first firstPath reference) (unique : reference.mode = .unique)
    (right : Route state pending second secondPath other)
    (target : other.object = reference.object) :
    first = second ∧ firstPath = secondPath ∧ other = reference := by
  induction left generalizing second secondPath other with
  | @root reference atRoot =>
    have ref : reference = .owned reference.object := reference_owned unique
    cases right with
    | root otherRoot =>
      obtain ⟨sameSite, sameReference⟩ := RootOwns.unique wf (ref ▸ atRoot) otherRoot target
      exact ⟨sameSite, rfl, sameReference.trans ref.symm⟩
    | field _ atObject atField =>
      exact False.elim ((ref ▸ atRoot).unique_not_field wf ⟨_, atObject, atField⟩ target)
  | @field path parent data name reference parentRoute atObject atField ih =>
    have modes : parent.mode = .unique ∧ reference.mode = .unique := by
      cases hm : parent.mode <;> cases hr : reference.mode <;>
        simp_all [enter, Mode.join]
    have ref := reference_owned modes.2
    have owned : Stored state (.field parent.object name) (some (.owned reference.object)) :=
      ⟨_, atObject, ref ▸ atField⟩
    cases right with
    | root atRoot => exact False.elim (atRoot.not_unique_field wf owned target)
    | @field _ otherParent otherData otherName otherReference otherPrefix otherObject otherField =>
      obtain ⟨samePlace, sameRef⟩ := unique_owner wf owned (show Stored state (.field otherParent.object otherName) _ from ⟨_, otherObject, otherField⟩) target
      have sameParent := (StoragePlace.field.inj samePlace).1
      have sameName := (StoragePlace.field.inj samePlace).2
      obtain ⟨sites, paths, parents⟩ := ih modes.1 otherPrefix sameParent
      exact ⟨sites, by rw [paths, sameName], by rw [parents, sameRef, ← ref]⟩

theorem Route.follow (route : Route state pending site initial reference)
    (read : readPath state reference path = some (some target)) :
    Route state pending site (initial ++ path) target := by
  induction path generalizing initial reference with
  | nil =>
    cases found : state.objects.lookup reference.object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst target
    simpa using route
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, slot, stored, atField, final | ⟨child, rfl, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, final⟩
      obtain ⟨child, rfl, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp final
      exact .field route stored atField
    · simpa [List.append_assoc] using ih (.field route stored atField) more

theorem Route.allocated (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (route : Route state pending site path reference) : Allocated state reference.object := by
  cases route with
  | root owner =>
    apply (wf.referencesComplete reference.object).mp
    cases owner with
    | «variable» stored =>
      exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_left _
        (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(_, some reference), stored, rfl⟩))
    | pending member => exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_map_of_mem member)
  | @field _ _ _ _ child _ stored atField =>
    exact field_allocated (reference := child) wf stored atField

theorem Route.mode_exclusive (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (unique : Route state pending first firstPath (.owned object))
    (shared : Route state pending second secondPath (.shared object)) : False := by
  have same := (unique.unique wf rfl shared rfl).2.2
  have mode := congrArg Reference.mode same
  cases mode

theorem route_of_resolve (resolved : Resolve state place source object permission) :
    Route state pending (.variable (splitPlace place).1) (splitPlace place).2
      ⟨permission, object⟩ := by
  induction resolved with
  | «variable» stored => exact .root (.variable stored)
  | field _ stored atField ih => exact .field ih stored atField

theorem resolve_readPath (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (resolved : Resolve state place source object permission) :
    ∃ root, ((splitPlace place).1, some root) ∈ state.variables ∧
      readPath state root (splitPlace place).2 = some (some ⟨permission, object⟩) := by
  induction resolved with
  | «variable» stored =>
    refine ⟨_, stored, readPath_nil_of_allocated wf ?_⟩
    apply (wf.referencesComplete _).mp
    exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_left _
      (List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(_, some _), stored, rfl⟩))
  | field previous stored atField ih =>
    obtain ⟨root, atRoot, read⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨root, atRoot, (readPath_append wf read [_]).trans
      (readPath_singleton_of_stored wf ⟨_, stored, atField⟩)⟩

theorem take_readPath_frame (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes after afterPending)
    (taken : Take before source removed after)
    (cut : Route before pending cutSite cutPath (.owned removed))
    (route : Route before pending site initial reference)
    (read : readPath before reference path = some slot)
    (separate : ¬ (site = cutSite ∧ cutPath.IsPrefix (initial ++ path))) :
    readPath after reference path = some slot := by
  induction path generalizing initial reference with
  | nil =>
    cases found : before.objects.lookup reference.object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst slot
    apply readPath_nil_of_allocated afterWf
    simpa [Allocated, taken.object_keys] using route.allocated wf
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, fieldSlot, stored, atField, final | ⟨child, same, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    all_goals
      have different : StoragePlace.field reference.object field ≠ source := by
        intro equalSource
        have sameSlot : fieldSlot = some (.owned removed) := stored_value_unique wf
          (show Stored before (.field reference.object field) fieldSlot from ⟨data, stored, atField⟩)
          (equalSource ▸ taken.stored)
        have crossing : Route before pending site (initial ++ [field])
            (enter reference.mode (.owned removed)) :=
          .field route stored (sameSlot ▸ atField)
        obtain ⟨sameSite, samePath, _⟩ := cut.unique wf rfl crossing rfl
        apply separate
        refine ⟨sameSite.symm, ?_⟩
        rw [samePath]
        exact ⟨rest, by simp [List.append_assoc]⟩
      have firstRead := readPath_singleton_of_stored afterWf
        (taken.stored_unchanged different (show Stored before (.field reference.object field) fieldSlot from
          ⟨data, stored, atField⟩))
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact firstRead
    · subst fieldSlot
      have remaining := ih (.field route stored atField) more (by
        simpa [List.append_assoc] using separate)
      exact (readPath_append afterWf firstRead rest).trans remaining

theorem take_readPath_below (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes after afterPending)
    (taken : Take before source removed after)
    (below : reference.object.index ≤ removed.index)
    (read : readPath before reference path = some slot) :
    readPath after reference path = some slot := by
  induction path generalizing reference with
  | nil =>
    cases found : before.objects.lookup reference.object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst slot
    apply readPath_nil_of_allocated afterWf
    rw [Allocated, taken.object_keys]
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, lookup_member found, rfl⟩
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, fieldSlot, stored, atField, final | ⟨child, same, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    all_goals
      have different : StoragePlace.field reference.object field ≠ source := by
        intro sameSource
        have sourceField : Stored before (.field reference.object field) (some (.owned removed)) :=
          sameSource ▸ taken.stored
        obtain ⟨sourceData, sourceStored, sourceAtField⟩ := sourceField
        have older := wf.older _ _ _ _ sourceStored sourceAtField
        change removed.index < reference.object.index at older
        omega
      have firstRead := readPath_singleton_of_stored afterWf
        (taken.stored_unchanged different (show Stored before (.field reference.object field) fieldSlot from
          ⟨data, stored, atField⟩))
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact firstRead
    · subst fieldSlot
      have childBelow := Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_of_lt (wf.older _ _ _ child stored atField)) below
      exact (readPath_append afterWf firstRead rest).trans (ih childBelow more)

theorem take_readPath_taken (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes after afterPending)
    (taken : Take before source reference.object after)
    (read : readPath before reference path = some slot) :
    readPath after reference path = some slot :=
  take_readPath_below wf afterWf taken (Nat.le_refl _) read

theorem take_readPath_back (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (taken : Take before source removed after)
    (read : readPath after reference path = some (some target)) :
    readPath before reference path = some (some target) := by
  induction path generalizing reference with
  | nil =>
    obtain ⟨data, stored⟩ := readPath_root_allocated read
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldStored, _, _, _⟩ := taken.object_data _ _ stored
    cases found : after.objects.lookup reference.object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst target
    simp [readPath, lookup_of_member wf.objectKeys oldStored]
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, slot, stored, atField, final | ⟨child, rfl, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, final⟩
      obtain ⟨child, rfl, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp final
      obtain ⟨oldData, oldStored, _, _, kept⟩ := taken.object_data _ _ stored
      exact readPath_singleton_of_stored wf ⟨oldData, oldStored, kept _ _ atField⟩
    · obtain ⟨oldData, oldStored, _, _, kept⟩ := taken.object_data _ _ stored
      have firstRead := readPath_singleton_of_stored (reference := reference) wf
        ⟨oldData, oldStored, kept _ _ atField⟩
      exact (readPath_append wf firstRead rest).trans (ih more)

theorem promote_readPath_frame (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes after afterPending)
    (promoted : Promote before source object after)
    (cut : Route before pending cutSite cutPath (.shared object))
    (route : Route before pending site initial reference)
    (read : readPath before reference path = some slot) :
    readPath after reference path = some slot := by
  induction path generalizing initial reference with
  | nil =>
    cases found : before.objects.lookup reference.object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst slot
    apply readPath_nil_of_allocated afterWf
    simpa [Allocated, promoted.object_keys] using route.allocated wf
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, fieldSlot, stored, atField, final | ⟨child, same, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    all_goals
      have firstRead : readPath after reference [field] =
          some (fieldSlot.map (enter reference.mode)) := by
        by_cases sameSource : StoragePlace.field reference.object field = source
        · have sameSlot : fieldSlot = some (.owned object) := stored_value_unique wf
            (show Stored before (.field reference.object field) fieldSlot from ⟨data, stored, atField⟩)
            (sameSource ▸ promoted.stored)
          have crossing : Route before pending site (initial ++ [field])
              (enter reference.mode (.owned object)) :=
            .field route stored (sameSlot ▸ atField)
          have sharedMode : reference.mode = .shared := by
            cases hmode : reference.mode with
            | shared => rfl
            | unique =>
              have uniqueCrossing : Route before pending site (initial ++ [field]) (.owned object) := by
                simpa [hmode] using crossing
              exact False.elim (uniqueCrossing.mode_exclusive wf cut)
          have newRead := readPath_singleton_of_stored (reference := reference) afterWf
            (sameSource ▸ promoted.promoted)
          simpa [sameSlot, sharedMode, Reference.shared, Reference.owned] using newRead
        · exact readPath_singleton_of_stored afterWf
            (promoted.stored_unchanged sameSource
              (show Stored before (.field reference.object field) fieldSlot from ⟨data, stored, atField⟩))
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact firstRead
    · subst fieldSlot
      exact (readPath_append afterWf firstRead rest).trans (ih (.field route stored atField) more)

theorem promote_readPath_below (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes after afterPending)
    (promoted : Promote before source object after)
    (below : reference.object.index ≤ object.index)
    (read : readPath before reference path = some slot) :
    readPath after reference path = some slot := by
  induction path generalizing reference with
  | nil =>
    cases found : before.objects.lookup reference.object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst slot
    apply readPath_nil_of_allocated afterWf
    rw [Allocated, promoted.object_keys]
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, lookup_member found, rfl⟩
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, fieldSlot, stored, atField, final | ⟨child, same, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    all_goals
      have different : StoragePlace.field reference.object field ≠ source := by
        intro sameSource
        have sourceField : Stored before (.field reference.object field) (some (.owned object)) :=
          sameSource ▸ promoted.stored
        obtain ⟨sourceData, sourceStored, sourceAtField⟩ := sourceField
        have older := wf.older _ _ _ _ sourceStored sourceAtField
        change object.index < reference.object.index at older
        omega
      have firstRead := readPath_singleton_of_stored afterWf
        (promoted.stored_unchanged different (show Stored before (.field reference.object field) fieldSlot from
          ⟨data, stored, atField⟩))
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
      exact firstRead
    · subst fieldSlot
      have childBelow := Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_of_lt (wf.older _ _ _ child stored atField)) below
      exact (readPath_append afterWf firstRead rest).trans (ih childBelow more)

theorem take_readPath_cleared (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes after afterPending)
    (taken : Take before source removed after) (nonempty : path ≠ [])
    (read : readPath before reference path = some (some target))
    (targetObject : target.object = removed) : readPath after reference path = some none := by
  induction path generalizing reference with
  | nil => exact False.elim (nonempty rfl)
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, fieldSlot, stored, atField, final | ⟨child, rfl, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, final⟩
      obtain ⟨child, rfl, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp final
      have same := (unique_owner wf taken.stored
        (show Stored before (.field reference.object field) (some child) from
          ⟨data, stored, atField⟩) targetObject).1
      exact readPath_singleton_of_stored afterWf (same ▸ taken.cleared)
    · by_cases empty : rest = []
      · subst rest
        cases found : before.objects.lookup child.object <;> simp [readPath, found] at more
        subst target
        have same := (unique_owner wf taken.stored
          (show Stored before (.field reference.object field) (some child) from
            ⟨data, stored, atField⟩) targetObject).1
        exact readPath_singleton_of_stored afterWf (same ▸ taken.cleared)
      · have different : StoragePlace.field reference.object field ≠ source := by
          intro same
          have equalSlot := stored_value_unique wf
            (show Stored before (.field reference.object field) (some child) from ⟨data, stored, atField⟩)
            (same ▸ taken.stored)
          have equalReference := Option.some.inj equalSlot
          have less := readPath_index_strict wf empty more
          simp [equalReference, targetObject, enter, Reference.owned] at less
        have firstRead := readPath_singleton_of_stored (reference := reference) afterWf
          (taken.stored_unchanged different
            (show Stored before (.field reference.object field) (some child) from ⟨data, stored, atField⟩))
        exact (readPath_append afterWf firstRead rest).trans (ih empty more)

theorem promote_readPath_back (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (promoted : Promote before source object after)
    (sameObject : first.object = second.object)
    (read : readPath after second path = some slot) :
    ∃ oldSlot, readPath before first path = some oldSlot ∧
      oldSlot.map Reference.object = slot.map Reference.object := by
  induction path generalizing first second slot with
  | nil =>
    obtain ⟨data, stored⟩ := readPath_root_allocated read
    obtain ⟨oldData, oldStored, _, _, _⟩ := promoted.object_data _ _ stored
    cases found : after.objects.lookup second.object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst slot
    refine ⟨some first, ?_, congrArg some sameObject⟩
    simp [readPath, sameObject, lookup_of_member wf.objectKeys oldStored]
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, fieldSlot, stored, atField, final | ⟨child, rfl, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := final
      obtain ⟨oldSlot, oldStored, targets⟩ := promoted.stored_back
        (show Stored after (.field second.object field) fieldSlot from ⟨data, stored, atField⟩)
      refine ⟨oldSlot.map (enter first.mode), ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact readPath_singleton_of_stored wf (sameObject ▸ oldStored)
      · simpa [Option.map_map, Function.comp_def] using targets
    · obtain ⟨oldSlot, oldStored, targets⟩ := promoted.stored_back
        (show Stored after (.field second.object field) (some child) from ⟨data, stored, atField⟩)
      obtain ⟨oldChild, rfl, sameTarget⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp targets
      obtain ⟨result, tailRead, resultTargets⟩ := ih
        (first := enter first.mode oldChild) (second := enter second.mode child) sameTarget more
      have firstRead := readPath_singleton_of_stored (reference := first) wf
        (sameObject ▸ oldStored)
      exact ⟨result, (readPath_append wf firstRead rest).trans tailRead, resultTargets⟩

theorem promote_readPath_eq (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes after afterPending)
    (promoted : Promote before source object after)
    (cut : Route before pending cutSite cutPath (.shared object))
    (route : Route before pending site initial reference) (path : List FieldName) :
    readPath after reference path = readPath before reference path := by
  cases beforeRead : readPath before reference path with
  | some slot => exact promote_readPath_frame wf afterWf promoted cut route beforeRead
  | none =>
    cases afterRead : readPath after reference path with
    | none => rfl
    | some slot =>
      obtain ⟨oldSlot, oldRead, _⟩ := promote_readPath_back wf promoted rfl afterRead
      rw [beforeRead] at oldRead
      contradiction

theorem promote_readPath_below_eq (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes after afterPending)
    (promoted : Promote before source object after)
    (below : reference.object.index ≤ object.index) (path : List FieldName) :
    readPath after reference path = readPath before reference path := by
  cases beforeRead : readPath before reference path with
  | some slot => exact promote_readPath_below wf afterWf promoted below beforeRead
  | none =>
    cases afterRead : readPath after reference path with
    | none => rfl
    | some slot =>
      obtain ⟨oldSlot, oldRead, _⟩ := promote_readPath_back wf promoted rfl afterRead
      rw [beforeRead] at oldRead
      contradiction

end Dada.Shared.Typing

import Shared.Soundness

namespace Dada.Shared.Typing

-- A reference returned by a path carries the permission of the entire route.
def enter (permission : Mode) (reference : Reference) : Reference :=
  ⟨permission.join reference.mode, reference.object⟩

section EnterProperties

@[simp] theorem enter_mode (permission : Mode) (reference : Reference) :
    (enter permission reference).mode = permission.join reference.mode := rfl

@[simp] theorem enter_object (permission : Mode) (reference : Reference) :
    (enter permission reference).object = reference.object := rfl

@[simp] theorem enter_unique (reference : Reference) : enter .unique reference = reference := by
  cases reference with
  | reference mode object => cases mode <;> rfl

@[simp] theorem enter_shared (reference : Reference) :
    enter .shared reference = .shared reference.object := by
  cases reference with
  | reference mode object => cases mode <;> rfl

theorem enter_assoc (first second : Mode) (reference : Reference) :
    enter first (enter second reference) = enter (first.join second) reference := by
  cases first <;> cases second <;> cases reference with
  | reference mode object => cases mode <;> rfl

end EnterProperties

-- An outer none means lookup failed; some none is an existing empty slot.
-- A final inhabited slot records the effective mode, not its stored mode.
def readPath (state : State) (reference : Reference) : List FieldName → Option Slot
  | [] => do
      let _ ← state.objects.lookup reference.object
      return some reference
  | field :: rest => do
      let data ← state.objects.lookup reference.object
      let slot ← data.fields.lookup field
      match rest with
      | [] => return slot.map (enter reference.mode)
      | _ :: _ => do
          let target ← slot
          readPath state (enter reference.mode target) rest

theorem lookup_member {Key Value : Type} [BEq Key] [LawfulBEq Key]
    {entries : List (Key × Value)} {key : Key} {value : Value}
    (found : entries.lookup key = some value) : (key, value) ∈ entries := by
  obtain ⟨before, after, rfl, _⟩ := List.lookup_eq_some_iff.mp found
  simp

theorem lookup_of_member {Key Value : Type} [BEq Key] [LawfulBEq Key]
    {entries : List (Key × Value)} {key : Key} {value : Value}
    (distinct : (entries.map Prod.fst).Nodup) (member : (key, value) ∈ entries) :
    entries.lookup key = some value := by
  induction entries with
  | nil => simp at member
  | cons entry entries ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨entryKey, entryValue⟩
    rcases List.nodup_cons.mp distinct with ⟨fresh, distinct⟩
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | member
    · cases same
      simp
    · have different : key ≠ entryKey := by
        intro same
        exact fresh (same ▸ List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(key, value), member, rfl⟩)
      simpa [List.lookup_cons, show (key == entryKey) = false from beq_eq_false_iff_ne.mpr different] using ih distinct member

theorem member_value_unique {Key Value : Type} [BEq Key] [LawfulBEq Key]
    {entries : List (Key × Value)} {key : Key} {first second : Value}
    (distinct : (entries.map Prod.fst).Nodup)
    (left : (key, first) ∈ entries) (right : (key, second) ∈ entries) : first = second := by
  exact Option.some.inj ((lookup_of_member distinct left).symm.trans
    (lookup_of_member distinct right))

theorem readPath_nil (state : State) (reference : Reference) :
    readPath state reference [] =
      (state.objects.lookup reference.object).map (fun _ => some reference) := by
  cases found : state.objects.lookup reference.object <;> simp [readPath, found]

theorem readPath_singleton (state : State) (reference : Reference) (field : FieldName) :
    readPath state reference [field] =
      ((state.objects.lookup reference.object).bind (fun data => data.fields.lookup field)).map
        (Option.map (enter reference.mode)) := by
  cases found : state.objects.lookup reference.object with
  | none => simp [readPath, found]
  | some data =>
    cases fieldFound : data.fields.lookup field <;> simp [readPath, found, fieldFound]

theorem readPath_empty (reference : Reference) (path : List FieldName) :
    readPath State.empty reference path = none := by
  cases path <;> simp [readPath, State.empty]

theorem readPath_root_allocated (read : readPath state reference path = some slot) :
    ∃ data, (reference.object, data) ∈ state.objects := by
  cases path <;> cases found : state.objects.lookup reference.object <;>
    simp [readPath, found] at read
  all_goals exact ⟨_, lookup_member found⟩

theorem readPath_cons (read : readPath state reference (field :: rest) = some slot) :
    ∃ data fieldSlot, (reference.object, data) ∈ state.objects ∧
      (field, fieldSlot) ∈ data.fields ∧
      (rest = [] ∧ fieldSlot.map (enter reference.mode) = slot ∨
        ∃ target, fieldSlot = some target ∧
          readPath state (enter reference.mode target) rest = some slot) := by
  cases objectFound : state.objects.lookup reference.object with
  | none => simp [readPath, objectFound] at read
  | some data =>
    cases fieldFound : data.fields.lookup field with
    | none => simp [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] at read
    | some fieldSlot =>
      refine ⟨data, fieldSlot, lookup_member objectFound, lookup_member fieldFound, ?_⟩
      cases rest with
      | nil => exact Or.inl ⟨rfl, by simpa [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] using read⟩
      | cons next rest =>
        cases fieldSlot with
        | none => simp [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] at read
        | some target =>
          exact Or.inr ⟨target, rfl, by simpa [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] using read⟩

theorem field_allocated (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (stored : (parent, data) ∈ state.objects) (field : (name, some reference) ∈ data.fields) :
    Allocated state reference.object := by
  apply (wf.referencesComplete reference.object).mp
  exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_flatMap.mpr
    ⟨(parent, data), stored, List.mem_filterMap.mpr ⟨(name, some reference), field, rfl⟩⟩))

theorem readPath_target_allocated (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (read : readPath state reference path = some (some target)) : Allocated state target.object := by
  induction path generalizing reference with
  | nil =>
    cases found : state.objects.lookup reference.object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst target
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, lookup_member found, rfl⟩
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, slot, stored, atField, final | ⟨next, rfl, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, final⟩
      obtain ⟨child, rfl, same⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp final
      subst target
      exact field_allocated (reference := child) wf stored atField
    · exact ih more

theorem readPath_index (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (read : readPath state reference path = some (some target)) :
    target.object.index ≤ reference.object.index := by
  induction path generalizing reference with
  | nil =>
    cases found : state.objects.lookup reference.object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst target
    exact Nat.le_refl _
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, slot, stored, atField, final | ⟨next, rfl, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, final⟩
      obtain ⟨child, rfl, same⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp final
      subst target
      exact Nat.le_of_lt (wf.older _ _ _ child stored atField)
    · exact Nat.le_trans (ih more) (Nat.le_of_lt (wf.older _ _ _ next stored atField))

theorem readPath_index_strict (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (nonempty : path ≠ []) (read : readPath state reference path = some (some target)) :
    target.object.index < reference.object.index := by
  cases path with
  | nil => exact False.elim (nonempty rfl)
  | cons field rest =>
    obtain ⟨data, slot, stored, atField, final | ⟨child, rfl, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, final⟩
      obtain ⟨child, rfl, same⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp final
      subst target
      exact wf.older _ _ _ child stored atField
    · exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (readPath_index wf more) (wf.older _ _ _ child stored atField)

theorem readPath_nil_of_allocated (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (allocated : Allocated state reference.object) :
    readPath state reference [] = some (some reference) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨id, data⟩, stored, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp allocated
  simp only at same
  subst id
  simp [readPath, lookup_of_member wf.objectKeys stored]

theorem readPath_append (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (read : readPath state reference path = some (some target)) (suffix : List FieldName) :
    readPath state reference (path ++ suffix) = readPath state target suffix := by
  induction path generalizing reference with
  | nil =>
    cases found : state.objects.lookup reference.object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst target
    rfl
  | cons field rest ih =>
    cases objectFound : state.objects.lookup reference.object with
    | none => simp [readPath, objectFound] at read
    | some data =>
      cases fieldFound : data.fields.lookup field with
      | none => simp [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] at read
      | some slot =>
        cases rest with
        | nil =>
          have same : slot.map (enter reference.mode) = some target := by
            simpa [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] using read
          obtain ⟨child, rfl, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp same
          cases suffix with
          | nil =>
            simpa using read.trans (readPath_nil_of_allocated wf
              (readPath_target_allocated wf read)).symm
          | cons next suffix => simp [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound]
        | cons next rest =>
          cases slot with
          | none => simp [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] at read
          | some child =>
            have tailRead : readPath state (enter reference.mode child) (next :: rest) =
                some (some target) := by
              simpa [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] using read
            simpa [readPath, objectFound, fieldFound] using ih tailRead

theorem readPath_append_inv (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (nonempty : suffix ≠ [])
    (read : readPath state reference (path ++ suffix) = some slot) :
    ∃ target, readPath state reference path = some (some target) ∧
      readPath state target suffix = some slot := by
  induction path generalizing reference with
  | nil =>
    obtain ⟨data, stored⟩ := readPath_root_allocated read
    exact ⟨reference, by simp [readPath, lookup_of_member wf.objectKeys stored], read⟩
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, fieldSlot, stored, atField, final | ⟨child, rfl, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    · have empty : rest = [] ∧ suffix = [] := by simpa using final.1
      exact False.elim (nonempty empty.2)
    · obtain ⟨target, prefixRead, suffixRead⟩ := ih more
      have fieldKeys : (data.fields.map Prod.fst).Nodup := by
        obtain ⟨declaration, _, same, distinct⟩ := wf.shapes reference.object data stored
        exact same ▸ distinct
      have firstRead : readPath state reference [field] =
          some (some (enter reference.mode child)) := by
        simp [readPath, lookup_of_member wf.objectKeys stored,
          lookup_of_member fieldKeys atField]
      exact ⟨target, (readPath_append wf firstRead rest).trans prefixRead, suffixRead⟩

theorem readPath_enter (state : State) (permission : Mode) (reference : Reference)
    (path : List FieldName) :
    readPath state (enter permission reference) path =
      (readPath state reference path).map (Option.map (enter permission)) := by
  induction path generalizing reference with
  | nil =>
    cases found : state.objects.lookup reference.object <;>
      simp [readPath, enter, found]
  | cons field rest ih =>
    cases found : state.objects.lookup reference.object with
    | none => simp [readPath, enter, found]
    | some data =>
      cases fieldFound : data.fields.lookup field with
      | none => simp [readPath, enter, found, fieldFound]
      | some slot =>
        cases rest with
        | nil =>
          cases slot <;>
            simp [readPath, found, fieldFound, enter_assoc]
        | cons next rest =>
          cases slot with
          | none => simp [readPath, found, fieldFound]
          | some target =>
            simpa [readPath, found, fieldFound, enter_assoc] using
              ih (enter reference.mode target)

theorem readPath_targets {first second : Reference} (same : first.object = second.object) (path : List FieldName) :
    (readPath state first path).map (Option.map Reference.object) =
      (readPath state second path).map (Option.map Reference.object) := by
  induction path generalizing first second with
  | nil => cases found : state.objects.lookup second.object <;> simp [readPath, same, found]
  | cons field rest ih =>
    cases objectFound : state.objects.lookup second.object with
    | none => simp [readPath, same, objectFound]
    | some data =>
      cases fieldFound : data.fields.lookup field with
      | none => simp [readPath, same, objectFound, fieldFound]
      | some slot =>
        cases rest with
        | nil => cases slot <;> simp [readPath, same, objectFound, fieldFound]
        | cons next rest =>
          cases slot with
          | none => simp [readPath, same, objectFound, fieldFound]
          | some child =>
            simpa [readPath, same, objectFound, fieldFound] using
              ih (first := enter first.mode child) (second := enter second.mode child) rfl

theorem resolve_follow (resolved : Resolve state base source object permission)
    (read : readPath state ⟨permission, object⟩ path = some (some target)) :
    ∃ destination, Resolve state (path.foldl Place.field base)
      destination target.object target.mode := by
  induction path generalizing base source object permission with
  | nil =>
    cases found : state.objects.lookup object <;> simp [readPath, found] at read
    subst target
    exact ⟨source, resolved⟩
  | cons field rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨data, slot, stored, atField, final | ⟨next, rfl, more⟩⟩ := readPath_cons read
    · rcases final with ⟨rfl, final⟩
      obtain ⟨child, rfl, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp final
      exact ⟨.field object field, .field resolved stored atField⟩
    · exact ih (.field resolved stored atField) more

theorem resolve_from_readPath (root : (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables)
    (read : readPath state reference path = some (some target)) :
    ∃ destination, Resolve state (path.foldl Place.field (.variable name))
      destination target.object target.mode := by
  cases reference
  exact resolve_follow (.variable root) read

theorem stored_value_unique (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (first : Stored state place left) (second : Stored state place right) : left = right := by
  cases place with
  | «variable» name => exact member_value_unique wf.variableKeys first second
  | field parent name =>
    obtain ⟨firstData, firstObject, firstField⟩ := first
    obtain ⟨secondData, secondObject, secondField⟩ := second
    have same := member_value_unique wf.objectKeys firstObject secondObject
    subst secondData
    obtain ⟨declaration, _, sameFields, distinct⟩ := wf.shapes parent firstData firstObject
    exact member_value_unique (sameFields ▸ distinct) firstField secondField

theorem readPath_singleton_of_stored (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (stored : Stored state (.field reference.object name) slot) :
    readPath state reference [name] = some (slot.map (enter reference.mode)) := by
  obtain ⟨data, atObject, atField⟩ := stored
  obtain ⟨declaration, _, sameFields, distinct⟩ := wf.shapes reference.object data atObject
  simp [readPath, lookup_of_member wf.objectKeys atObject,
    lookup_of_member (sameFields ▸ distinct) atField]

theorem resolve_deterministic (wf : WellFormedWith classes state pending)
    (first : Resolve state place source object permission)
    (second : Resolve state place other target mode) :
    source = other ∧ object = target ∧ permission = mode := by
  induction first generalizing other target mode with
  | «variable» stored =>
    cases second with
    | «variable» otherStored =>
      have same := Option.some.inj (member_value_unique wf.variableKeys stored otherStored)
      cases same
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  | @field base source parent permission data name reference resolved stored atField ih =>
    cases second with
    | @field _ _ otherParent _ otherData _ otherReference otherResolved otherStored otherField =>
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := ih otherResolved
      have sameData := member_value_unique wf.objectKeys stored otherStored
      subst otherData
      obtain ⟨declaration, _, sameFields, distinct⟩ := wf.shapes _ _ stored
      have same := Option.some.inj
        (member_value_unique (sameFields ▸ distinct) atField otherField)
      cases same
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

end Dada.Shared.Typing

namespace Dada.Shared

theorem Resolve.stored (resolved : Resolve state place source object permission) :
    ∃ reference, Stored state source (some reference) ∧ reference.object = object := by
  cases resolved with
  | «variable» stored => exact ⟨_, stored, rfl⟩
  | field _ stored field => exact ⟨_, ⟨_, stored, field⟩, rfl⟩

theorem Resolve.stored_unique (resolved : Resolve state place source object permission)
    (unique : permission = .unique) : Stored state source (some (.owned object)) := by
  cases resolved with
  | @«variable» name reference stored =>
    cases reference with
    | reference mode object =>
      dsimp at unique
      subst mode
      exact stored
  | @field base source parent permission data name reference baseResolved stored field =>
    have modes : permission = .unique ∧ reference.mode = .unique := by
      cases permission <;> cases h : reference.mode <;> simp_all [Mode.join]
    cases reference with
    | reference mode object =>
      dsimp at modes
      rw [modes.2] at field
      exact ⟨_, stored, field⟩

theorem Resolve.unique_stored (resolved : Resolve state place source object .unique) :
    Stored state source (some (.owned object)) := resolved.stored_unique rfl

theorem Stored.take_exists (stored : Stored state source (some (.owned object))) :
    ∃ after, Take state source object after := by
  cases state with
  | mk objects variables nextId =>
    cases source with
    | «variable» name =>
      obtain ⟨before, after, equality⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp stored
      dsimp at equality
      subst variables
      exact ⟨_, .variable ..⟩
    | field parent name =>
      obtain ⟨⟨className, fields⟩, stored, field⟩ := stored
      obtain ⟨before, after, equality⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp stored
      obtain ⟨leading, suffix, fieldsEquality⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp field
      dsimp at equality fieldsEquality
      subst objects fields
      exact ⟨_, .field ..⟩

theorem Stored.promote_exists (stored : Stored state source (some (.owned object))) :
    ∃ after, Promote state source object after := by
  cases state with
  | mk objects variables nextId =>
    cases source with
    | «variable» name =>
      obtain ⟨before, after, equality⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp stored
      dsimp at equality
      subst variables
      exact ⟨_, .variable ..⟩
    | field parent name =>
      obtain ⟨⟨className, fields⟩, stored, field⟩ := stored
      obtain ⟨before, after, equality⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp stored
      obtain ⟨leading, suffix, fieldsEquality⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp field
      dsimp at equality fieldsEquality
      subst objects fields
      exact ⟨_, .field ..⟩

theorem Resolve.give_exists (resolved : Resolve state path source object permission) :
    ∃ after, Give state path ⟨permission, object⟩ after := by
  cases permission with
  | unique =>
    obtain ⟨after, taken⟩ := resolved.unique_stored.take_exists
    exact ⟨after, .move resolved taken⟩
  | shared =>
    obtain ⟨⟨mode, target⟩, stored, rfl⟩ := resolved.stored
    cases mode with
    | shared => exact ⟨state, .copy resolved stored⟩
    | unique =>
      obtain ⟨after, promoted⟩ := stored.promote_exists
      exact ⟨after, .promote resolved promoted⟩

theorem Give.resolved (given : Give before path reference after) :
    ∃ source, Resolve before path source reference.object reference.mode := by
  cases given with
  | move resolved _ => exact ⟨_, resolved⟩
  | copy resolved _ => exact ⟨_, resolved⟩
  | promote resolved _ => exact ⟨_, resolved⟩

end Dada.Shared

import Shared.TypingGiveEffects

namespace Dada.Shared.Typing

-- Promotion changes one stored reference, but every route to that slot already
-- has shared access. Existing references therefore retain their observations.
theorem Satisfies.promote_frame (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes.erase after afterPending)
    (promoted : Promote before source object after)
    (cut : Route before pending cutSite cutPath (.shared object))
    (route : Route before pending site initial reference)
    (satisfied : Satisfies classes before reference ty) :
    Satisfies classes after reference ty := by
  constructor
  · exact satisfied.mode
  · obtain ⟨data, stored, correct⟩ := satisfied.root
    obtain ⟨newData, newStored, same⟩ := promoted.old_object_data reference.object data stored
    exact ⟨newData, newStored, same.trans correct⟩
  · intro path positive
    obtain ⟨target, data, read, stored, correct⟩ := satisfied.positive path positive
    obtain ⟨newData, newStored, same⟩ := promoted.old_object_data target.object data stored
    exact ⟨target, newData, (promote_readPath_eq wf afterWf promoted cut route path).trans read,
      newStored, same ▸ correct⟩
  · intro path negative
    exact (promote_readPath_eq wf afterWf promoted cut route path).trans
      (satisfied.negative path negative)
  · intro path target permission declared read
    rw [promote_readPath_eq wf afterWf promoted cut route path] at read
    exact satisfied.modes path target permission declared read

-- The promoted object's own fields lie below its incoming reference in the
-- allocation order. Their contents and permissions do not change.
theorem Satisfies.promote_target (wf : WellFormedWith classes.erase before pending)
    (afterWf : WellFormedWith classes.erase after afterPending)
    (promoted : Promote before source reference.object after)
    (satisfied : Satisfies classes before reference ty) :
    Satisfies classes after reference ty := by
  constructor
  · exact satisfied.mode
  · obtain ⟨data, stored, correct⟩ := satisfied.root
    obtain ⟨newData, newStored, same⟩ := promoted.old_object_data reference.object data stored
    exact ⟨newData, newStored, same.trans correct⟩
  · intro path positive
    obtain ⟨target, data, read, stored, correct⟩ := satisfied.positive path positive
    obtain ⟨newData, newStored, same⟩ := promoted.old_object_data target.object data stored
    exact ⟨target, newData,
      (promote_readPath_below_eq wf afterWf promoted (Nat.le_refl _) path).trans read,
      newStored, same ▸ correct⟩
  · intro path negative
    exact (promote_readPath_below_eq wf afterWf promoted (Nat.le_refl _) path).trans
      (satisfied.negative path negative)
  · intro path target permission declared read
    rw [promote_readPath_below_eq wf afterWf promoted (Nat.le_refl _) path] at read
    exact satisfied.modes path target permission declared read

private theorem promotion_source_field_general (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (resolved : Resolve before place source object permission)
    (shared : permission = .shared)
    (promoted : Promote before source object after) :
    ∃ parent field, source = .field parent field := by
  cases resolved with
  | @«variable» name reference stored =>
    have same := stored_value_unique wf promoted.stored stored
    have modes := congrArg (fun slot => slot.map Reference.mode) same
    simp [Reference.owned, shared] at modes
  | field _ _ _ => exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩

theorem promotion_source_field (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (resolved : Resolve before place source object .shared)
    (promoted : Promote before source object after) :
    ∃ parent field, source = .field parent field :=
  promotion_source_field_general wf resolved rfl promoted

theorem promotion_preserves_variables (wf : WellFormedWith classes before pending)
    (resolved : Resolve before place source object .shared)
    (promoted : Promote before source object after) : after.variables = before.variables := by
  obtain ⟨parent, field, sourceField⟩ := promotion_source_field wf resolved promoted
  cases promoted with
  | «variable» => cases sourceField
  | field => rfl

theorem Realizes.promote (realized : Realizes classes environment before pending)
    (resolved : Resolve before place source object .shared)
    (promoted : Promote before source object after)
    (admissible : Admissible classes ty)
    (target : Satisfies classes after (.shared object) ty) :
    Realizes classes environment after ((Reference.shared object, ty) :: pending) := by
  have afterOwnership := (Give.promote resolved promoted).preserves_pending realized.ownership
  have variables := promotion_preserves_variables realized.ownership resolved promoted
  have cut := route_of_resolve (pending := pending.map Prod.fst) resolved
  constructor
  · exact realized.classesWellFormed
  · exact realized.environmentWellFormed
  · intro root view member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | member
    · cases same; exact admissible
    · exact realized.pendingTypes root view member
  · exact afterOwnership
  · exact realized.fields.promote promoted
  · intro name
    rw [variables]
    exact realized.variableDomain name
  · intro name member
    rw [variables]
    exact realized.emptyVariables name member
  · intro name view member
    obtain ⟨root, atRoot, satisfied⟩ := realized.initializedVariables name view member
    exact ⟨root, variables ▸ atRoot,
      satisfied.promote_frame realized.ownership afterOwnership promoted cut
        (.root (.variable atRoot))⟩
  · intro root view member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | member
    · cases same; exact target
    · exact (realized.pendingValues root view member).promote_frame realized.ownership
        afterOwnership promoted cut
        (.root (.pending (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(root, view), member, rfl⟩)))

theorem Realizes.copy (realized : Realizes classes environment state pending)
    (resolved : Resolve state place source object .shared)
    (stored : Stored state source (some (.shared object)))
    (admissible : Admissible classes ty)
    (target : Satisfies classes state (.shared object) ty) :
    Realizes classes environment state ((Reference.shared object, ty) :: pending) := by
  refine { realized with
    pendingTypes := ?_,
    ownership := (Give.copy resolved stored).preserves_pending realized.ownership,
    pendingValues := ?_ }
  · intro root view member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | member
    · cases same; exact admissible
    · exact realized.pendingTypes root view member
  · intro root view member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with same | member
    · cases same; exact target
    · exact realized.pendingValues root view member

end Dada.Shared.Typing

import Shared.TypingPaths

namespace Dada.Shared.Typing

-- A view describes access from this reference. Different aliases can expose
-- different views of the same object, but all routes obey declared permissions.
structure Satisfies (classes : ClassTable) (state : State) (reference : Reference) (ty : ValueType) : Prop where
  mode : reference.mode = ty.permission.toMode
  root : ∃ data, (reference.object, data) ∈ state.objects ∧ data.className = ty.nominal.className
  positive : ∀ path, Pos classes ty path →
    ∃ target data, readPath state reference path = some (some target) ∧
      (target.object, data) ∈ state.objects ∧
      Unique.Typing.classAt classes.nominal ty.nominal.className path = some data.className
  negative : ∀ path, Neg ty path → readPath state reference path = some none
  modes : ∀ path target permission,
    declaredPermission classes ty.nominal.className path = some permission →
    readPath state reference path = some (some target) →
    target.mode = (ty.permission.comp permission).toMode

-- Nominal field correctness also covers fields hidden by a view.
def FieldsMatchClasses (classes : ClassTable) (state : State) : Prop :=
  ∀ parent data field target, (parent, data) ∈ state.objects →
    (field, some target) ∈ data.fields →
    ∃ declaration fieldType targetData,
      (data.className, declaration) ∈ classes ∧
      (field, fieldType) ∈ declaration.fields ∧
      (target.object, targetData) ∈ state.objects ∧ targetData.className = fieldType.className

abbrev PendingValues := List (Reference × ValueType)

structure Realizes (classes : ClassTable) (environment : Environment) (state : State) (pending : PendingValues) : Prop where
  classesWellFormed : classes.WellFormed
  environmentWellFormed : environment.WellFormed classes
  pendingTypes : ∀ reference ty, (reference, ty) ∈ pending → Admissible classes ty
  ownership : WellFormedWith classes.erase state (pending.map Prod.fst)
  fields : FieldsMatchClasses classes state
  variableDomain : ∀ name,
    name ∈ environment.map Prod.fst ↔ name ∈ state.variables.map Prod.fst
  emptyVariables : ∀ name, (name, none) ∈ environment → (name, none) ∈ state.variables
  initializedVariables : ∀ name ty, (name, some ty) ∈ environment →
    ∃ reference, (name, some reference) ∈ state.variables ∧ Satisfies classes state reference ty
  pendingValues : ∀ reference ty, (reference, ty) ∈ pending →
    Satisfies classes state reference ty

theorem Satisfies.weaken (satisfied : Satisfies classes state reference source)
    (sourceNormal : Normalized classes source) (targetNormal : Normalized classes target)
    (subtype : Subtype classes source target) : Satisfies classes state reference target := by
  obtain ⟨samePermission, sameClass, positives, negatives⟩ := subtype
  unfold Normalized Unique.Typing.Normalized at sourceNormal targetNormal
  rw [sourceNormal, targetNormal] at positives negatives
  constructor
  · exact satisfied.mode.trans (congrArg Perm.toMode samePermission)
  · obtain ⟨data, stored, correct⟩ := satisfied.root
    exact ⟨data, stored, correct.trans sameClass⟩
  · intro path positive
    obtain ⟨result, data, read, stored, correct⟩ := satisfied.positive path (positives path positive)
    exact ⟨result, data, read, stored, sameClass ▸ correct⟩
  · intro path negative
    exact satisfied.negative path (negatives path negative)
  · intro path result permission declared read
    rw [← samePermission]
    exact satisfied.modes path result permission (sameClass ▸ declared) read

theorem Realizes.empty {classes : ClassTable} (classesWellFormed : classes.WellFormed) :
    Realizes classes [] State.empty [] := by
  constructor
  · exact classesWellFormed
  · simp [Environment.WellFormed]
  · simp
  · exact (WellFormed.empty classes.erase).with_pending
  · simp [FieldsMatchClasses, State.empty]
  · simp [State.empty]
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp

theorem Realizes.perm (realized : Realizes classes environment state pending)
    (permutation : pending.Perm other) : Realizes classes environment state other := by
  refine { realized with
    pendingTypes := ?_, ownership := realized.ownership.perm (permutation.map Prod.fst),
    pendingValues := ?_ }
  · intro reference ty member
    exact realized.pendingTypes reference ty (permutation.mem_iff.mpr member)
  · intro reference ty member
    exact realized.pendingValues reference ty (permutation.mem_iff.mpr member)

theorem Realizes.weaken_pending
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state ((reference, ty) :: pending))
    (admissible : Admissible classes other) (subtype : Subtype classes ty other) :
    Realizes classes environment state ((reference, other) :: pending) := by
  have original := realized.pendingTypes reference ty (by simp)
  refine { realized with pendingTypes := ?_, pendingValues := ?_ }
  · intro root view member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with equal | member
    · cases equal; exact admissible
    · exact realized.pendingTypes root view (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)
  · intro root view member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with equal | member
    · cases equal
      exact (realized.pendingValues reference ty (by simp)).weaken original.2 admissible.2 subtype
    · exact realized.pendingValues root view (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)

theorem Realizes.next_fresh (realized : Realizes classes environment state pending) :
    ObjectId.mk state.nextId ∉ state.objects.map Prod.fst := by
  intro member
  obtain ⟨⟨object, data⟩, stored, same⟩ := List.mem_map.mp member
  dsimp at same
  subst object
  exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ (realized.ownership.bounds _ _ stored)

theorem Satisfies.share (satisfied : Satisfies classes state reference ty) :
    Satisfies classes state (.shared reference.object) ty.shared := by
  constructor
  · rfl
  · exact satisfied.root
  · intro path known
    obtain ⟨target, data, read, stored, correct⟩ := satisfied.positive path known
    refine ⟨.shared target.object, data, ?_, stored, correct⟩
    have sharedRead := readPath_enter state .shared reference path
    simpa [read] using sharedRead
  · intro path known
    have sharedRead := readPath_enter state .shared reference path
    simpa [satisfied.negative path known] using sharedRead
  · intro path target permission _ read
    rw [← enter_shared reference, readPath_enter] at read
    obtain ⟨slot, _, mapped⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp read
    obtain ⟨old, _, equal⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.mp mapped
    subst target
    cases old.mode <;> cases permission <;> rfl

theorem Realizes.share_pending
    (realized : Realizes classes environment state ((reference, ty) :: pending))
    (structTy : StructType classes ty) :
    Realizes classes environment state ((Reference.shared reference.object, ty.shared) :: pending) := by
  refine { realized with
    pendingTypes := ?_, ownership := realized.ownership.share_result,
    pendingValues := ?_ }
  · intro root view member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with equal | member
    · cases equal
      exact (realized.pendingTypes reference ty (by simp)).share structTy
    · exact realized.pendingTypes root view (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)
  · intro root view member
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp member with equal | member
    · cases equal
      exact (realized.pendingValues reference ty (by simp)).share
    · exact realized.pendingValues root view (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ member)

end Dada.Shared.Typing

namespace Dada.Shared.Typing

section FromExpressionSoundness

variable {classes : ClassTable}
variable (expressionSound : ∀ before value ty after,
  ExprTyped classes before value ty after → ExpressionSound classes before value ty after)

include expressionSound

theorem ConfigurationTyped.progress_of_expression
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment) :
    configuration.finished ∨ ∃ after, Unpacking.Step classes.erase configuration after := by
  obtain ⟨current, realized, sequence⟩ := typed
  rcases configuration with ⟨state, code⟩
  cases code with
  | nil => exact Or.inl rfl
  | cons statement rest =>
    cases sequence with
    | cons first remaining =>
      cases first with
      | letValue expression binding =>
        have sound := expressionSound _ _ _ _ expression state [] realized
        obtain ⟨evaluated, object, evaluation⟩ := sound.1
        have current := sound.2 evaluated object evaluation
        obtain ⟨after, operation⟩ := binding.exists_bind current
        exact Or.inr ⟨⟨after, rest⟩, .letValue evaluation operation⟩

theorem ConfigurationTyped.preservation_of_expression
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes before finalEnvironment)
    (step : Unpacking.Step classes.erase before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes after finalEnvironment := by
  obtain ⟨current, realized, sequence⟩ := typed
  cases step with
  | letValue evaluation operation =>
    cases sequence with
    | cons first rest =>
      cases first with
      | letValue expression binding =>
        have evaluated := (expressionSound _ _ _ _ expression _ [] realized).2 _ _ evaluation
        exact ⟨_, binding.preserves_realization evaluated operation, rest⟩

theorem ConfigurationTyped.trace_of_expression
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes before finalEnvironment)
    (trace : Unpacking.Steps classes.erase before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes after finalEnvironment := by
  induction trace with
  | refl => exact typed
  | step first _ rest =>
    exact rest (typed.preservation_of_expression expressionSound first)

theorem ConfigurationTyped.finishes_of_expression
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment) :
    ∃ final, Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase configuration configuration.code.length final ∧
      final.finished ∧ Realizes classes finalEnvironment final.state [] := by
  have decreasing : ∀ (count : Nat) (configuration : Unpacking.Configuration), configuration.code.length = count →
      ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment →
      ∃ final, Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase configuration count final ∧
        final.finished ∧ Realizes classes finalEnvironment final.state [] := by
    intro count
    induction count with
    | zero =>
      intro configuration empty typed
      have finished : configuration.finished := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp empty
      exact ⟨configuration, .refl _, finished, typed.finished finished⟩
    | succ count ih =>
      intro configuration length typed
      rcases typed.progress_of_expression expressionSound with finished | ⟨after, step⟩
      · have empty : configuration.code = [] := finished
        simp [empty] at length
      · have shorter := step.code_length
        have nextLength : after.code.length = count := by omega
        obtain ⟨final, rest, finished, realized⟩ := ih after nextLength
          (typed.preservation_of_expression expressionSound step)
        exact ⟨final, .step step rest, finished, realized⟩
  exact decreasing _ configuration rfl typed

end FromExpressionSoundness

-- The public results discharge the expression premise with the proved static
-- soundness theorem; no operational-success assumption appears here.
theorem expression_soundness
    (typed : ExprTyped classes before value ty after)
    (realized : Realizes classes before state pending) :
    (∃ result object, Eval classes.erase state value result object) ∧
    (∀ result object, Eval classes.erase state value result object →
      Realizes classes after result (pending ++ [(object, ty)])) := by
  have sound := typed.sound state pending realized
  refine ⟨sound.1, fun result object evaluated => ?_⟩
  exact (sound.2 result object evaluated).perm (by simpa using (List.perm_middle (a := (object, ty)) (l₁ := pending) (l₂ := [])).symm)

theorem ConfigurationTyped.progress
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment) :
    configuration.finished ∨ ∃ after, Unpacking.Step classes.erase configuration after :=
  typed.progress_of_expression (fun _ _ _ _ expression => expression.sound)

theorem ConfigurationTyped.preservation
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes before finalEnvironment)
    (step : Unpacking.Step classes.erase before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes after finalEnvironment :=
  typed.preservation_of_expression (fun _ _ _ _ expression => expression.sound) step

theorem ConfigurationTyped.trace
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes before finalEnvironment)
    (steps : Unpacking.Steps classes.erase before after) :
    ConfigurationTyped classes after finalEnvironment :=
  typed.trace_of_expression (fun _ _ _ _ expression => expression.sound) steps

theorem ConfigurationTyped.finishes
    (typed : ConfigurationTyped classes configuration finalEnvironment) :
    ∃ final, Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase configuration configuration.code.length final ∧
      final.finished ∧ Realizes classes finalEnvironment final.state [] :=
  typed.finishes_of_expression (fun _ _ _ _ expression => expression.sound)

-- Every finite execution prefix remains safe and can be completed. The counted
-- continuation gives exactly one transition per original statement overall.
theorem program_safety (classesWf : classes.WellFormed)
    (typed : SequenceTyped classes [] code finalEnvironment)
    (execution : Unpacking.Steps classes.erase ⟨State.empty, code⟩ configuration) :
    ¬ Unpacking.Stuck classes.erase configuration ∧
    (configuration.finished ∨ ∃ next, Unpacking.Step classes.erase configuration next) ∧
    ∃ final prefixLength,
      Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase ⟨State.empty, code⟩ prefixLength configuration ∧
      Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase configuration configuration.code.length final ∧
      prefixLength + configuration.code.length = code.length ∧
      Unpacking.StepsExactly classes.erase ⟨State.empty, code⟩ code.length final ∧
      final.finished ∧ Realizes classes finalEnvironment final.state [] := by
  have initial : ConfigurationTyped classes ⟨State.empty, code⟩ finalEnvironment :=
    ⟨[], Realizes.empty classesWf, typed⟩
  have current := initial.trace execution
  have progress := current.progress
  refine ⟨?_, progress, ?_⟩
  · intro stuck
    rcases progress with finished | next
    · exact stuck.1 finished
    · exact stuck.2 next
  · obtain ⟨final, completion, finished, realized⟩ := current.finishes
    obtain ⟨count, counted⟩ := execution.counted
    have length : count + configuration.code.length = code.length := counted.length.symm
    exact ⟨final, count, counted, completion, length,
      length ▸ counted.trans completion, finished, realized⟩

end Dada.Shared.Typing
